Two Models, One Platform

## Two Ways to Use Local Delivery

Businesses use Getcho in two distinct ways — and many run both simultaneously.

### Customer-Facing Delivery

Offer same-day or scheduled delivery as a visible checkout option. Customers see delivery windows, pick a time slot, and pay a delivery fee. Higher conversion, higher average order value, and a differentiated experience that keeps customers coming back.
Customer sees "Same-day delivery — select a window"
ETA precision 1-2 hour delivery windows
Best for Perishables, gifts, urgent orders, premium experience

### Ship from Store

Fulfill online orders from your nearest store instead of a warehouse. The customer selects "standard shipping" — but a local courier delivers from a nearby location in hours instead of days. Faster, cheaper, less packaging, and the customer doesn't even know it happened.
Customer sees "Standard shipping" (but arrives same-day)
Cost to business Often less than national carrier rates for local orders
Best for Local orders, multi-store retailers, reducing shipping costs

The most effective businesses use both: customer-facing delivery as a premium upsell, and ship-from-store fulfillment to get local orders there faster and cheaper than national carriers.

## FAQ (full answers)

### What is Getcho?

Getcho is a delivery operations platform that runs your entire last-mile operation — from dispatching drivers across multiple fleets, to monitoring every order with AI, to keeping your customers updated with branded tracking. We handle the complexity so you can focus on your business.

### What platforms does Getcho integrate with?

We integrate with Shopify, Shopify POS (including POS Lite via our native POS Extension with tabbed packing queue and barcode scan), RICS Software, Packiyo, CleanCloud, Slack, WhatsApp, and custom APIs. Whatever your business runs on, we can connect to it.

### How does Getcho's AI work?

Same-day delivery touches technology, logistics, retail operations, and customer experience — all at once. Our AI ties all four together: it dispatches the best fleet, monitors every order in real-time, calls drivers with instructions in their preferred language, sends customers SMS and email updates at every step, and only escalates to your team when a human is truly needed. It's like having a delivery operations team that never sleeps.

### What types of businesses use Getcho?

Retailers, specialty grocers, luxury brands, florists, wineries, bakeries, 3PL warehouses, laundry services, rental businesses, and any company that needs reliable local delivery. Whether you use your own drivers, third-party fleets, or a mix of both — Getcho handles it.

### Does Getcho offer white-label delivery tracking?

Yes. You can brand your tracking pages, SMS, and email notifications to your business — your logo, your colors, your voice. Customers see your brand at every touchpoint, not a generic courier logo. Branding is optional and configurable per account.

### What areas does Getcho service?

Getcho delivers nationwide across the United States. Our multi-fleet network provides coverage in major metros and smaller markets alike.

### How quickly can Getcho deliver?

Deliveries are typically dispatched within minutes. Our multi-signal dispatch sends your order to multiple fleets simultaneously — first available driver wins the job. We also support scheduled, next-day, and recurring deliveries.

### How much does a delivery cost?

Pricing is flexible — we offer subscription plans, per-delivery pricing, and custom volume pricing. Contact us for a quote tailored to your business.

### Do I need my own delivery fleet?

No. Getcho connects you to a network of delivery service providers. You don't need your own fleet — but if you do have drivers, we can manage them alongside third-party fleets from a single dashboard.

### How long does setup take?

Shopify stores can be live in minutes. Custom integrations typically go live in under a day. Connect your platform, configure your preferences, and start dispatching.

## Pricing questions

How much does delivery management software cost? Getcho starts at $0/month for up to 100 deliveries. Paid plans are $99/month (500 deliveries included) and $349/month (2,500 included), with per-delivery overage rates of $1.50 and $1.10. High-volume operations get custom rates from $0.75 per delivery.
Is the free plan really free? Yes — up to 100 deliveries a month, 2 drivers, and 1 location, with no card required. It exists so you can run real orders through Getcho before paying anything.
What happens if I go over my monthly delivery limit? Nothing stops. Overage rates apply automatically mid-month, and if a higher plan would have been cheaper, we tell you. Deliveries are never blocked by a billing limit.
How does Delivery Forensics pricing work? On any paid plan there is no base fee — you pay $0.15 per verified order plus 10% of claims we recover for you. Standalone (with any other carrier or courier) it is $29/month plus the same usage rates.
Can I use Delivery Forensics without using Getcho for deliveries? Yes. Standalone Forensics works with orders delivered by any carrier or courier — connect your order source and it verifies proof of delivery, flags risky orders, and files claims.

## Delivery Analytics and Operations

Visibility into every delivery. Track performance, identify bottlenecks, and make data-driven decisions about your delivery operations.

Our native Shopify POS Extension embeds the same-day delivery queue directly in Shopify POS (including POS Lite) — tabbed task view, barcode verification with the POS camera, and one-tap courier dispatch.
How does AI Fleet Matching work? When a delivery is created, the platform automatically selects the optimal carrier and vehicle type for the order. No manual dispatch or phone calls needed — every delivery is matched, dispatched, and tracked without operator intervention.
Can I use Getcho for multiple store locations? Yes. Getcho supports multi-location routing, which means orders are automatically routed to the nearest store or warehouse with available inventory. You manage all locations from a single dashboard.
What notification channels does Getcho support? Getcho sends delivery notifications via SMS, email, WhatsApp, and Slack. Voice Agents also make automated phone calls to drivers at key delivery milestones — pickup instructions, gate codes, and delivery details. Customers receive branded SMS and email notifications. All notifications can be branded to your business — your logo, your colors, your voice.
Does Getcho support same-day delivery? Yes. Getcho specializes in same-day delivery — orders are dispatched automatically to the optimal carrier within minutes. We also support next-day, scheduled, and recurring delivery windows so your customers can choose what works for them.
What vehicle types are available? Getcho provides access to sedans, SUVs, vans, cargo vans, and box trucks with lift gates through our fleet network. Vehicles are matched to each delivery based on item size, weight, and distance.
How do I get started with Getcho? Request a demo and our team will walk you through the platform. Shopify stores can be live in minutes — install from the App Store and start dispatching. Custom integrations like Packiyo, CleanCloud, and APIs typically go live in under a day with our team handling setup.
Can I use Getcho for standard shipping orders instead of same-day? Yes. Many businesses use Getcho for ship-from-store fulfillment on standard shipping orders. Instead of handing the package to FedEx or UPS, you route it through a local carrier from your nearest store for faster, cheaper delivery. The customer sees "standard shipping" at checkout but gets it in hours instead of days. This approach also reduces packaging costs — short transit means no gel packs or heavy insulation for perishable items.

## FAQ (full answers)

### What is Getcho?

Getcho ("get-cho") is a delivery platform designed for businesses. We simplify local deliveries, pickups, and returns using AI-powered tools to reduce errors, improve reliability, and scale operations—helping businesses meet customer expectations and grow without adding staff.

### How do I get started?

Request a demo at getcho.app. From there, we will set up your business dashboard and integrate your Shopify store or other systems as needed.

### What platforms does Getcho integrate with?

We integrate with Shopify, Shopify POS (including POS Lite via our native POS Extension), RICS Software, Packiyo, CleanCloud, Slack, WhatsApp, and custom APIs. Whatever your business needs, we can build it. Schedule a demo to discuss your specific integration requirements.

### Does Getcho work inside Shopify POS?

Yes. The Getcho Shopify POS Extension embeds the same-day delivery queue directly in Shopify POS — including POS Lite, with no POS Pro subscription required. Your team sees a tabbed task view (Need to Pack, On Pickup, On Dropoff, Delivered), scans items with the POS camera for barcode verification, and dispatches a courier in one tap. Slack or SMS pings when a new order hits the queue.

### How does Getcho's AI help my business?

Our AI manages the complex logistics so you don't have to—from smart fleet matching to automatic issue resolution. We handle all the operational details, allowing you to focus on growing your business.

### How does Getcho scale with my business?

Getcho helps businesses handle high delivery volumes by enabling one manager to oversee many deliveries at once, cutting costs and improving efficiency.

### What scale of deliveries can Getcho handle?

Getcho can handle very large delivery volumes. We've successfully processed over 100 orders in under 2 hours for clients. Our AI-powered platform scales to meet your business needs, whether you're doing 10 deliveries a day or 1,000+.

### What types of businesses use Getcho?

Getcho is trusted by a wide range of businesses, including wineries managing direct-to-consumer deliveries, high-end produce and specialty food businesses, stores supporting store-to-store or warehouse-to-store transfers, high-end retailers offering same-day or scheduled deliveries, clothing boutiques, florists and gift shops, rental businesses managing drop-offs and pickups, and SMBs looking to scale logistics without increasing headcount.

### What kind of analytics does Getcho provide?

We provide comprehensive analytics including cart conversion data, customer sentiment analysis, and detailed delivery metrics. These insights help you optimize your delivery operations and improve customer satisfaction.

### How much does a delivery cost?

Pricing is flexible based on your business needs. We offer subscription plans, per-delivery pricing, and custom pricing for larger volumes. Contact us for more details.

### Does Getcho offer white-label delivery tracking?

Yes, you can custom-brand all tracking experiences to match your business. Your customers get a consistent, branded experience regardless of which fleet delivers their order. Branding is optional and fully configurable.

### Can I manage multiple locations with Getcho?

Yes, Getcho supports multi-location businesses by centralizing delivery management, enabling seamless coordination between stores, warehouses, and customers.

### Can I customize delivery zones and hours?

Yes, you can configure custom delivery zones by zip code or radius from your store locations. You can also set specific delivery hours and days to match your business operations.

### Does Getcho support custom integrations?

Yes, we can build custom integrations to meet your business needs. As developers at heart, we're ready to create tailored solutions—just reach out to request custom integrations.

### Does Getcho support bulk order uploads?

Yes, we allow bulk order imports to streamline large-scale delivery scheduling and processing.

### What areas does Getcho service?

Getcho delivers nationwide across the United States. Whether you are in a major metro area or a smaller market, our multi-fleet network provides coverage wherever your customers are.

### What can my business send with Getcho?

Businesses use Getcho to deliver items like retail orders, returns, rental equipment, and more. We support everything from sedans for a few items to box trucks with lift gates—our AI finds the best fleet for each delivery. Contact us if you have special delivery requirements.

### Can Getcho handle time-sensitive or perishable deliveries?

Yes. Short transit times are the best protection for perishable items — same-day local delivery means your products spend minutes in transit, not days. Pair that with your own packaging and Getcho handles the rest. Contact us to discuss your specific requirements.

### Can I track my delivery?

Yes, all deliveries include real-time tracking, audit logs, and proof-of-delivery photos to ensure transparency and reliability. Premium plans offer a custom tracking link and allow multiple recipients to receive updates and notifications on orders.

### What types of notifications do my customers receive?

Customers receive real-time updates via SMS or email, including order confirmations, delivery tracking, and proof-of-delivery notifications.

### What insurance options are available?

Insurance coverage is available for your deliveries. Options range from standard coverage to custom policies for higher-value items based on your average cargo value. Contact us to discuss the right coverage for your business.

### What happens if a delivery goes wrong?

We use AI-powered follow-ups to resolve issues quickly, reducing claims and improving customer satisfaction. In cases where issues cannot be resolved immediately, insurance coverage options are available to protect your shipments.

### Can Getcho handle returns?

Yes, Getcho supports local returns, including same-day return pickups. We also offer a Shopify integration that streamlines the return process for both regular purchases and rental items.

### Does Getcho support rentals?

Yes, we support businesses offering rentals by managing deliveries and pickups for rental items. Customers can schedule flexible delivery and return times to meet their needs.

### Does Getcho support round trips?

Yes. Getcho supports same-day round trips, where a single driver completes the delivery and returns to your store on the same run — bringing back signed paperwork, reusable totes and containers, or equipment. A driver can also make a stop and come back to where they started, all in one dispatched job.

### Can Getcho handle recurring deliveries?

Yes, we support recurring and subscription-based deliveries. We save customer profiles and delivery preferences, so the experience is consistent—customers don't have to repeat their instructions with each delivery.

### Can I schedule a delivery in advance?

Yes, deliveries can be scheduled up to 7 days in advance, ensuring flexibility and convenience.

### How quickly can Getcho deliver a package?

Deliveries are typically dispatched within minutes. Multi-signal dispatch sends your order to multiple fleets simultaneously — the first available driver wins. Most orders are completed within hours.

### How will I know if something goes wrong with a pickup — like a driver grabbing the wrong order?

You'll be notified, fast. Getcho actively monitors every delivery and surfaces issues like a mismatched or missed pickup so your team can send a replacement right away. You choose how you hear about it — Slack, SMS, or email — and notifications are fully configurable. For most stores we also recommend barcode verification at pickup, which scans each item against the order so the wrong package is caught before it ever leaves the door. And when it's a no-harm mix-up (a driver marks picked up without actually grabbing the order, or returns unnecessarily), Getcho will often redispatch on the store's behalf automatically — frequently before anyone has to lift a finger. We stay very hands-on with our store teams.

### What happens after I send an order to Getcho via API, and how fast is it assigned to a driver?

For all intents and purposes, immediately. Once a quote is accepted, the order enters dispatch. Our most common workflow assigns the cheapest available carrier, and in that case the order is assigned to a delivery partner right away. If speed is what you care about most, we can optimize for the fastest available driver instead — dispatch is modular, so we're happy to chat about what fits your operation. For orders scheduled in advance, the same applies as the delivery window approaches, and scheduled orders can be canceled for free up until dispatch.

### Can I update an order after it has been sent to Getcho but before a driver is assigned?

Yes — this happens all the time, and we use APIs to update orders on the fly. Before a driver is assigned, order details can be modified directly. Even after a driver has picked up, reach out and we can usually still get updated instructions where they need to go.

### If a driver is already assigned and I need to cancel because the order isn't ready, how does that work — and who covers the cost?

It depends on timing. If a driver is already en route, the fleet usually charges a cancellation fee, which is passed along. If the cancellation was due to a Getcho dispatch mistake, Getcho may absorb that fee. And if "not ready yet" is something your store runs into regularly, let's talk — we've got solutions, including dispatching only once an order is actually packed rather than purely around the scheduled window.

# Privacy Policy

Last Updated: September 2025

Your privacy is very important to us. Accordingly, we have developed this Policy in order for you to understand how we collect, use, communicate and disclose and make use of personal information when you use our website, mobile application and other online products. The following outlines our privacy policy.

We are committed to conducting our business in accordance with these principles in order to ensure that the confidentiality of personal information is protected and maintained.

## Collection Of Information

We collect information you provide directly to us, like your email when you create an account, fill out a form, or request a delivery. However, the data collected is not linked to your identity.

Information We May Collect When You Use the Service:

- Location Information: We may collect information about the location of your device or otherwise consent to the collection of this information. This helps you create delivery requests.

- Device Information: We collect information about the device you use to access our Services. This allows us to do things like display buttons and other elements in the app in a way that's easy to use.

- Log Information: We collect log information about your use of the Services, including the type of browser you use, access times, pages viewed, your IP address and the page you visited before navigating to our Services.

## Use Of Information

We may use information about you for various purposes, including:

- Sending support messages or responding to your comments.

- Keeping you updated with your delivery statuses.

## Sharing Of Information

We do not share any of your information.

## Security

We will protect personal information by reasonable security safeguards against loss or theft, as well as unauthorized access, disclosure, copying, use or modification.

Our security measures include industry-standard encryption for data transmission, secure servers with regular security updates, and restricted access to personal information on a need-to-know basis. We regularly review and update our security practices to ensure your information remains protected.

## Data Retention

We retain your personal information only as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, including for the purposes of satisfying any legal, regulatory, accounting, or reporting requirements. When we no longer need your personal information, we securely delete or anonymize it.

Delivery-related information such as addresses and contact details are typically retained for up to 2 years after your last delivery for customer service purposes, unless otherwise required by law or requested for deletion by you.

## Your Rights and Choices

You have several rights regarding your personal information:

- Access: You can request access to the personal information we hold about you.

- Correction: You can request that we correct any inaccurate or incomplete personal information.

- Deletion: You can request that we delete your personal information, subject to certain exceptions.

- Opt-out: You can opt-out of certain communications from us, such as marketing emails.

To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at support@getcho.app . We will respond to your request within 30 days.

## Cookies and Tracking

Our website and mobile application may use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your experience and analyze usage patterns. These technologies help us remember your preferences, understand how you interact with our services, and improve our platform.

You can control cookie settings through your browser preferences. However, disabling certain cookies may limit your ability to use some features of our service.

## Third-Party Services

Our services may integrate with third-party services such as payment processors, mapping services, and analytics providers. These third parties have their own privacy policies and data handling practices. We encourage you to review their privacy policies before providing any personal information.

We do not sell, trade, or otherwise transfer your personal information to third parties for their marketing purposes without your explicit consent.

## Changes to This Policy

We may update this privacy policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. We will notify you of any significant changes by posting the new policy on our website and updating the "Last Updated" date.

Your continued use of our services after any changes indicates your acceptance of the updated privacy policy.

## Contact Information

If you have any questions about this privacy policy, our data practices, or would like to exercise your rights regarding your personal information, please contact us:

Getcho Privacy Team

Email: support@getcho.app

Subject Line: Privacy Policy Inquiry

# How Getcho Works: Delivery Orchestration | Getcho

**URL:** [https://getcho.app/how-getcho-works/](https://getcho.app/how-getcho-works/)

How It Works

# From your store to the client's door.

You sell. We deliver. Every order is dispatched, monitored, and verified automatically — across a network of vetted fleets with vehicles from mopeds to box trucks.
Request a Demo

01

## Tell Us What to Deliver

Submit deliveries through our dispatch form, your Shopify cart widget at checkout, your Shopify POS register, or our API — whatever works for you. No integration required to get started.

- Start with our dispatch form — no setup, no integration needed

- Shopify cart widget surfaces zones, time slots, and pricing dynamically based on the customer address

- Shopify POS Extension (POS Lite supported) lets store teams dispatch from the register

- Set delivery zones, hours, pricing rules, and eligible products

02

## AI Dispatches the Right Driver

When an order comes in, our system matches it to the best available driver and vehicle from our multi-fleet network. Voice agents can confirm inventory with the store team before the courier rolls.

- Matches vehicle type to package size — mopeds to box trucks

- Selects the nearest available driver to minimize wait time

- Inventory confirmation flow: voice agents call the store to verify items are picked and ready

- Item substitution on Shopify orders via the native order-edit API when something is out of stock

- Handles same-day, scheduled, and recurring deliveries

- Same-day round trips: a driver delivers and brings paperwork, totes, or equipment back to your store on the same run

03

## We Manage the Entire Delivery

From pickup to drop-off, every delivery is monitored. Drivers get clear instructions, customers get branded updates, and you get peace of mind.

- Drivers receive pickup instructions, gate codes, and navigation

- Customers get branded SMS and email updates with live tracking

- AI voice agents call drivers if they need help — in their language

04

## Issues Are Handled Before You Notice

Our Watchdog and Recovery Workflows monitor every delivery in real-time. If a driver stops too long, goes off-route, unassigns, or breaches an SLA — it is handled automatically.

- Unplanned stops, route deviations, and ETA swings are flagged instantly

- Recovery Workflows auto-reassign to a backup fleet on SLA breach or driver no-show

- AI voice agents reach out to drivers when human-style coordination is faster than re-dispatch

- You only hear about it if something truly needs your attention

05

## Delivery Verified, Claims Auto-Filed

Every delivery is scored with photo verification, GPS confirmation, and driver logs. If something goes wrong, claims are filed automatically.

- Pickup and drop-off photos verified by AI

- GPS confirms driver was at the correct location

- Damaged or missing deliveries trigger automatic claims with full evidence

06

## Full Visibility, Zero Effort

Your dashboard shows every delivery across every fleet. Weekly reports, delivery scores, and issue breakdowns — all without lifting a finger.

- Real-time dashboard with live delivery status across all fleets

- Weekly reports with delivery scores, success rates, and avg times

- Slack, WhatsApp, and email alerts for your team

## Ready to stop managing deliveries?

Book a 15-minute demo and see how Getcho handles everything from dispatch to proof of delivery.
Request a Demo

## FAQ (full answers)

### What is Getcho?

Getcho ("get-cho") is a delivery platform designed for businesses. We simplify local deliveries, pickups, and returns using AI-powered tools to reduce errors, improve reliability, and scale operations—helping businesses meet customer expectations and grow without adding staff.

### How do I get started?

Request a demo at getcho.app. From there, we will set up your business dashboard and integrate your Shopify store or other systems as needed.

### What platforms does Getcho integrate with?

We integrate with Shopify, Shopify POS (including POS Lite via our native POS Extension), RICS Software, Packiyo, CleanCloud, Slack, WhatsApp, and custom APIs. Whatever your business needs, we can build it. Schedule a demo to discuss your specific integration requirements.

### Does Getcho work inside Shopify POS?

Yes. The Getcho Shopify POS Extension embeds the same-day delivery queue directly in Shopify POS — including POS Lite, with no POS Pro subscription required. Your team sees a tabbed task view (Need to Pack, On Pickup, On Dropoff, Delivered), scans items with the POS camera for barcode verification, and dispatches a courier in one tap. Slack or SMS pings when a new order hits the queue.

### How does Getcho's AI help my business?

Our AI manages the complex logistics so you don't have to—from smart fleet matching to automatic issue resolution. We handle all the operational details, allowing you to focus on growing your business.

### How does Getcho scale with my business?

Getcho helps businesses handle high delivery volumes by enabling one manager to oversee many deliveries at once, cutting costs and improving efficiency.

### What scale of deliveries can Getcho handle?

Getcho can handle very large delivery volumes. We've successfully processed over 100 orders in under 2 hours for clients. Our AI-powered platform scales to meet your business needs, whether you're doing 10 deliveries a day or 1,000+.

### What types of businesses use Getcho?

Getcho is trusted by a wide range of businesses, including wineries managing direct-to-consumer deliveries, high-end produce and specialty food businesses, stores supporting store-to-store or warehouse-to-store transfers, high-end retailers offering same-day or scheduled deliveries, clothing boutiques, florists and gift shops, rental businesses managing drop-offs and pickups, and SMBs looking to scale logistics without increasing headcount.

### What kind of analytics does Getcho provide?

We provide comprehensive analytics including cart conversion data, customer sentiment analysis, and detailed delivery metrics. These insights help you optimize your delivery operations and improve customer satisfaction.

### How much does a delivery cost?

Pricing is flexible based on your business needs. We offer subscription plans, per-delivery pricing, and custom pricing for larger volumes. Contact us for more details.

### Does Getcho offer white-label delivery tracking?

Yes, you can custom-brand all tracking experiences to match your business. Your customers get a consistent, branded experience regardless of which fleet delivers their order. Branding is optional and fully configurable.

### Can I manage multiple locations with Getcho?

Yes, Getcho supports multi-location businesses by centralizing delivery management, enabling seamless coordination between stores, warehouses, and customers.

### Can I customize delivery zones and hours?

Yes, you can configure custom delivery zones by zip code or radius from your store locations. You can also set specific delivery hours and days to match your business operations.

### Does Getcho support custom integrations?

Yes, we can build custom integrations to meet your business needs. As developers at heart, we're ready to create tailored solutions—just reach out to request custom integrations.

### Does Getcho support bulk order uploads?

Yes, we allow bulk order imports to streamline large-scale delivery scheduling and processing.

### What areas does Getcho service?

Getcho delivers nationwide across the United States. Whether you are in a major metro area or a smaller market, our multi-fleet network provides coverage wherever your customers are.

### What can my business send with Getcho?

Businesses use Getcho to deliver items like retail orders, returns, rental equipment, and more. We support everything from sedans for a few items to box trucks with lift gates—our AI finds the best fleet for each delivery. Contact us if you have special delivery requirements.

### Can Getcho handle time-sensitive or perishable deliveries?

Yes. Short transit times are the best protection for perishable items — same-day local delivery means your products spend minutes in transit, not days. Pair that with your own packaging and Getcho handles the rest. Contact us to discuss your specific requirements.

### Can I track my delivery?

Yes, all deliveries include real-time tracking, audit logs, and proof-of-delivery photos to ensure transparency and reliability. Premium plans offer a custom tracking link and allow multiple recipients to receive updates and notifications on orders.

### What types of notifications do my customers receive?

Customers receive real-time updates via SMS or email, including order confirmations, delivery tracking, and proof-of-delivery notifications.

### What insurance options are available?

Insurance coverage is available for your deliveries. Options range from standard coverage to custom policies for higher-value items based on your average cargo value. Contact us to discuss the right coverage for your business.

### What happens if a delivery goes wrong?

We use AI-powered follow-ups to resolve issues quickly, reducing claims and improving customer satisfaction. In cases where issues cannot be resolved immediately, insurance coverage options are available to protect your shipments.

### Can Getcho handle returns?

Yes, Getcho supports local returns, including same-day return pickups. We also offer a Shopify integration that streamlines the return process for both regular purchases and rental items.

### Does Getcho support rentals?

Yes, we support businesses offering rentals by managing deliveries and pickups for rental items. Customers can schedule flexible delivery and return times to meet their needs.

### Does Getcho support round trips?

Yes. Getcho supports same-day round trips, where a single driver completes the delivery and returns to your store on the same run — bringing back signed paperwork, reusable totes and containers, or equipment. A driver can also make a stop and come back to where they started, all in one dispatched job.

### Can Getcho handle recurring deliveries?

Yes, we support recurring and subscription-based deliveries. We save customer profiles and delivery preferences, so the experience is consistent—customers don't have to repeat their instructions with each delivery.

### Can I schedule a delivery in advance?

Yes, deliveries can be scheduled up to 7 days in advance, ensuring flexibility and convenience.

### How quickly can Getcho deliver a package?

Deliveries are typically dispatched within minutes. Multi-signal dispatch sends your order to multiple fleets simultaneously — the first available driver wins. Most orders are completed within hours.

### How will I know if something goes wrong with a pickup — like a driver grabbing the wrong order?

You'll be notified, fast. Getcho actively monitors every delivery and surfaces issues like a mismatched or missed pickup so your team can send a replacement right away. You choose how you hear about it — Slack, SMS, or email — and notifications are fully configurable. For most stores we also recommend barcode verification at pickup, which scans each item against the order so the wrong package is caught before it ever leaves the door. And when it's a no-harm mix-up (a driver marks picked up without actually grabbing the order, or returns unnecessarily), Getcho will often redispatch on the store's behalf automatically — frequently before anyone has to lift a finger. We stay very hands-on with our store teams.

### What happens after I send an order to Getcho via API, and how fast is it assigned to a driver?

For all intents and purposes, immediately. Once a quote is accepted, the order enters dispatch. Our most common workflow assigns the cheapest available carrier, and in that case the order is assigned to a delivery partner right away. If speed is what you care about most, we can optimize for the fastest available driver instead — dispatch is modular, so we're happy to chat about what fits your operation. For orders scheduled in advance, the same applies as the delivery window approaches, and scheduled orders can be canceled for free up until dispatch.

### Can I update an order after it has been sent to Getcho but before a driver is assigned?

Yes — this happens all the time, and we use APIs to update orders on the fly. Before a driver is assigned, order details can be modified directly. Even after a driver has picked up, reach out and we can usually still get updated instructions where they need to go.

### If a driver is already assigned and I need to cancel because the order isn't ready, how does that work — and who covers the cost?

It depends on timing. If a driver is already en route, the fleet usually charges a cancellation fee, which is passed along. If the cancellation was due to a Getcho dispatch mistake, Getcho may absorb that fee. And if "not ready yet" is something your store runs into regularly, let's talk — we've got solutions, including dispatching only once an order is actually packed rather than purely around the scheduled window.

How It Works

## You place the order. We handle everything else.

Step 1

### Submit your delivery

Orders come in from your Shopify store, API, or our dispatch form. However they arrive, they auto-route to the right vehicle and fleet.

Step 2

### Auto-routed to the right vehicle

Based on item size, weight, and distance, we route each delivery to the best vehicle class from our partner network. No manual selection needed.

Step 3

### Track everything in real time

Monitor every delivery with AI-powered tracking, automated customer updates, and proof-of-delivery verification.

## FAQ (full answers)

### What vehicle types does Getcho support?

We support mopeds, sedans, SUVs, pickup trucks, cargo vans, 26-foot trucks, and 53-foot trucks. Our AI automatically matches each order to the right vehicle based on item size, weight, and delivery requirements.

### Does Getcho deliver nationwide?

Yes. Our network of delivery partners covers all 50 states. Whether you need same-day delivery in a major metro or scheduled delivery to a rural area, we have coverage.

### How does Getcho choose which vehicle to send?

Our AI considers item dimensions, weight, fragility, delivery urgency, and route efficiency. If an order needs a lift gate or temperature control, that factors in automatically. You can also specify vehicle requirements manually.

### Can I request a specific vehicle type?

Yes. When placing an order through our dashboard or API, you can specify the vehicle type. You can also set default vehicle preferences per product type or delivery route.

### Do larger vehicles cost more?

Pricing scales with vehicle size, distance, and urgency. A sedan delivery costs less than a 26-foot truck, but we optimize routing to keep costs down. Contact us for volume pricing on larger vehicles.

### Can Getcho handle both local and long-distance deliveries?

Yes. Our fleet network handles everything from a 2-mile moped run to a cross-country 53-foot truck haul. Same-day, next-day, and scheduled options are available for all vehicle types.

### Do your trucks have lift gates?

Lift gates are available on our pickup trucks, cargo vans, 26-foot trucks, and 53-foot trucks. You can specify lift gate requirements when placing an order.

### How fast can you dispatch a vehicle?

Most vehicles are dispatched within minutes. Our multi-signal dispatch sends your order to multiple fleet partners simultaneously — the first available driver with the right vehicle wins the job.

## FAQ (full answers)

### What is Getcho?

Getcho ("get-cho") is a delivery platform designed for businesses. We simplify local deliveries, pickups, and returns using AI-powered tools to reduce errors, improve reliability, and scale operations—helping businesses meet customer expectations and grow without adding staff.

### How do I get started?

Request a demo at getcho.app. From there, we will set up your business dashboard and integrate your Shopify store or other systems as needed.

### What platforms does Getcho integrate with?

We integrate with Shopify, Shopify POS (including POS Lite via our native POS Extension), RICS Software, Packiyo, CleanCloud, Slack, WhatsApp, and custom APIs. Whatever your business needs, we can build it. Schedule a demo to discuss your specific integration requirements.

### Does Getcho work inside Shopify POS?

Yes. The Getcho Shopify POS Extension embeds the same-day delivery queue directly in Shopify POS — including POS Lite, with no POS Pro subscription required. Your team sees a tabbed task view (Need to Pack, On Pickup, On Dropoff, Delivered), scans items with the POS camera for barcode verification, and dispatches a courier in one tap. Slack or SMS pings when a new order hits the queue.

### How does Getcho's AI help my business?

Our AI manages the complex logistics so you don't have to—from smart fleet matching to automatic issue resolution. We handle all the operational details, allowing you to focus on growing your business.

### How does Getcho scale with my business?

Getcho helps businesses handle high delivery volumes by enabling one manager to oversee many deliveries at once, cutting costs and improving efficiency.

### What scale of deliveries can Getcho handle?

Getcho can handle very large delivery volumes. We've successfully processed over 100 orders in under 2 hours for clients. Our AI-powered platform scales to meet your business needs, whether you're doing 10 deliveries a day or 1,000+.

### What types of businesses use Getcho?

Getcho is trusted by a wide range of businesses, including wineries managing direct-to-consumer deliveries, high-end produce and specialty food businesses, stores supporting store-to-store or warehouse-to-store transfers, high-end retailers offering same-day or scheduled deliveries, clothing boutiques, florists and gift shops, rental businesses managing drop-offs and pickups, and SMBs looking to scale logistics without increasing headcount.

### What kind of analytics does Getcho provide?

We provide comprehensive analytics including cart conversion data, customer sentiment analysis, and detailed delivery metrics. These insights help you optimize your delivery operations and improve customer satisfaction.

### How much does a delivery cost?

Pricing is flexible based on your business needs. We offer subscription plans, per-delivery pricing, and custom pricing for larger volumes. Contact us for more details.

### Does Getcho offer white-label delivery tracking?

Yes, you can custom-brand all tracking experiences to match your business. Your customers get a consistent, branded experience regardless of which fleet delivers their order. Branding is optional and fully configurable.

### Can I manage multiple locations with Getcho?

Yes, Getcho supports multi-location businesses by centralizing delivery management, enabling seamless coordination between stores, warehouses, and customers.

### Can I customize delivery zones and hours?

Yes, you can configure custom delivery zones by zip code or radius from your store locations. You can also set specific delivery hours and days to match your business operations.

### Does Getcho support custom integrations?

Yes, we can build custom integrations to meet your business needs. As developers at heart, we're ready to create tailored solutions—just reach out to request custom integrations.

### Does Getcho support bulk order uploads?

Yes, we allow bulk order imports to streamline large-scale delivery scheduling and processing.

### What areas does Getcho service?

Getcho delivers nationwide across the United States. Whether you are in a major metro area or a smaller market, our multi-fleet network provides coverage wherever your customers are.

### What can my business send with Getcho?

Businesses use Getcho to deliver items like retail orders, returns, rental equipment, and more. We support everything from sedans for a few items to box trucks with lift gates—our AI finds the best fleet for each delivery. Contact us if you have special delivery requirements.

### Can Getcho handle time-sensitive or perishable deliveries?

Yes. Short transit times are the best protection for perishable items — same-day local delivery means your products spend minutes in transit, not days. Pair that with your own packaging and Getcho handles the rest. Contact us to discuss your specific requirements.

### Can I track my delivery?

Yes, all deliveries include real-time tracking, audit logs, and proof-of-delivery photos to ensure transparency and reliability. Premium plans offer a custom tracking link and allow multiple recipients to receive updates and notifications on orders.

### What types of notifications do my customers receive?

Customers receive real-time updates via SMS or email, including order confirmations, delivery tracking, and proof-of-delivery notifications.

### What insurance options are available?

Insurance coverage is available for your deliveries. Options range from standard coverage to custom policies for higher-value items based on your average cargo value. Contact us to discuss the right coverage for your business.

### What happens if a delivery goes wrong?

We use AI-powered follow-ups to resolve issues quickly, reducing claims and improving customer satisfaction. In cases where issues cannot be resolved immediately, insurance coverage options are available to protect your shipments.

### Can Getcho handle returns?

Yes, Getcho supports local returns, including same-day return pickups. We also offer a Shopify integration that streamlines the return process for both regular purchases and rental items.

### Does Getcho support rentals?

Yes, we support businesses offering rentals by managing deliveries and pickups for rental items. Customers can schedule flexible delivery and return times to meet their needs.

### Does Getcho support round trips?

Yes. Getcho supports same-day round trips, where a single driver completes the delivery and returns to your store on the same run — bringing back signed paperwork, reusable totes and containers, or equipment. A driver can also make a stop and come back to where they started, all in one dispatched job.

### Can Getcho handle recurring deliveries?

Yes, we support recurring and subscription-based deliveries. We save customer profiles and delivery preferences, so the experience is consistent—customers don't have to repeat their instructions with each delivery.

### Can I schedule a delivery in advance?

Yes, deliveries can be scheduled up to 7 days in advance, ensuring flexibility and convenience.

### How quickly can Getcho deliver a package?

Deliveries are typically dispatched within minutes. Multi-signal dispatch sends your order to multiple fleets simultaneously — the first available driver wins. Most orders are completed within hours.

### How will I know if something goes wrong with a pickup — like a driver grabbing the wrong order?

You'll be notified, fast. Getcho actively monitors every delivery and surfaces issues like a mismatched or missed pickup so your team can send a replacement right away. You choose how you hear about it — Slack, SMS, or email — and notifications are fully configurable. For most stores we also recommend barcode verification at pickup, which scans each item against the order so the wrong package is caught before it ever leaves the door. And when it's a no-harm mix-up (a driver marks picked up without actually grabbing the order, or returns unnecessarily), Getcho will often redispatch on the store's behalf automatically — frequently before anyone has to lift a finger. We stay very hands-on with our store teams.

### What happens after I send an order to Getcho via API, and how fast is it assigned to a driver?

For all intents and purposes, immediately. Once a quote is accepted, the order enters dispatch. Our most common workflow assigns the cheapest available carrier, and in that case the order is assigned to a delivery partner right away. If speed is what you care about most, we can optimize for the fastest available driver instead — dispatch is modular, so we're happy to chat about what fits your operation. For orders scheduled in advance, the same applies as the delivery window approaches, and scheduled orders can be canceled for free up until dispatch.

### Can I update an order after it has been sent to Getcho but before a driver is assigned?

Yes — this happens all the time, and we use APIs to update orders on the fly. Before a driver is assigned, order details can be modified directly. Even after a driver has picked up, reach out and we can usually still get updated instructions where they need to go.

### If a driver is already assigned and I need to cancel because the order isn't ready, how does that work — and who covers the cost?

It depends on timing. If a driver is already en route, the fleet usually charges a cancellation fee, which is passed along. If the cancellation was due to a Getcho dispatch mistake, Getcho may absorb that fee. And if "not ready yet" is something your store runs into regularly, let's talk — we've got solutions, including dispatching only once an order is actually packed rather than purely around the scheduled window.

# Deliver Locally Without Building a Fleet

Getcho is a delivery orchestration platform that connects your business to a network of on-demand drivers. No fleet ownership, no driver management, no courier contracts.

How It Works

## Three Steps to Your First Delivery

1

### Connect Your Store

Install the Shopify app or connect via API. Your orders flow into Getcho automatically — no manual entry, no CSV uploads.

2

### Configure Your Preferences

Set delivery zones, cutoff times, eligible products, and pricing. Choose whether to auto-dispatch or manually approve each delivery.

3

### Start Delivering

Orders are dispatched to the best available fleet. AI monitors every delivery, calls drivers with instructions, and sends your customers real-time updates.

Platform

## What Your Business Gets

Everything you need to offer reliable local delivery — without hiring drivers, signing carrier contracts, or building delivery software.

AI Fleet Matching Every order is matched to the right driver and vehicle from a network that includes DoorDash Drive, Uber Direct, Roadie, Frayt, Lugg, and more. The AI factors in distance, vehicle size, time window, and cost — no manual dispatch needed.

AI Voice Agents Our AI calls delivery drivers with pickup instructions, gate codes, and parking details — in their preferred language. Drivers get the information they need without your team picking up the phone.

Real-Time Tracking GPS tracking on every delivery. Your team monitors all active orders from the dashboard. Customers receive tracking pages with live driver location, ETA, and proof-of-delivery photos.

Automated Notifications SMS, email, WhatsApp, and Slack alerts at every delivery milestone. Notifications can be branded to your business — your logo, your colors, your voice. Your team gets Slack alerts; your customers get branded updates.

## FAQ (full answers)

### What is Getcho?

Getcho is a delivery orchestration platform that connects your business to a network of delivery fleets — DoorDash Drive, Uber Direct, Roadie, Frayt, Lugg, and more. Our AI dispatches the right driver and vehicle for every order, monitors every delivery in real-time, and keeps your customers updated with branded tracking. You manage everything from one dashboard.

### How quickly can my business start delivering?

Shopify stores can be live in minutes — install the app, connect your store, and start dispatching. For other platforms like Packiyo, CleanCloud, or custom APIs, setup typically takes under a day with our team handling the integration.

### Do I need my own delivery fleet?

No. Getcho connects you to a network of delivery service providers so you do not need your own drivers. But if you do have an in-house fleet, we can manage them alongside third-party fleets from a single dashboard.

### What types of businesses use Getcho?

Retailers, specialty grocers, florists, bakeries, wineries, luxury brands, 3PL warehouses, laundry services, rental businesses, and any company that needs reliable local delivery. Whether you ship 5 orders a day or 200+, Getcho scales with you.

### What areas does Getcho service?

Getcho delivers nationwide across the United States, including major metros and smaller markets. Our multi-fleet network covers urban, suburban, and regional delivery zones.

### How much does delivery cost?

Getcho offers a free plan to get started. Beyond that, pricing is flexible — per-delivery pricing, subscription plans, and custom volume pricing are all available. Contact us for a quote tailored to your business.

### What integrations does Getcho support?

Getcho integrates with Shopify, Shopify POS, Packiyo, CleanCloud, Slack, WhatsApp, and custom APIs. Orders from your platform automatically flow into Getcho for dispatch — no manual data entry.

### Can I brand the delivery experience?

Yes. Tracking pages, SMS notifications, and email updates can all be branded with your logo, colors, and messaging. Customers see your brand at every touchpoint, not a generic courier logo. Branding is optional and configurable per account.

# Ecommerce Privacy Policy & Notice

Your privacy and your customers' privacy are very important to us. This policy outlines how we collect, use, and protect personal data when customers make ecommerce purchases and use our services.

Getcho uses the contact information provided at checkout to arrange delivery details via text messages.

## Collection of Customer Information

We collect essential personal information during the checkout process to coordinate deliveries and ensure a smooth experience.

Information We May Collect Includes:

-

Customer Data:

Name, phone number, email address, and shipping address.

-

Order Information:

Product details, quantities, and prices.

-

Payment Information:

Processed securely by payment providers; we do not store sensitive payment data.

## Use of Information

We use customer information to:

- - Coordinate delivery times via text messages.

- - Send order confirmations and updates.

- - Provide customer support and address inquiries.

## Sharing of Information

Customer data is shared only with trusted partners, such as delivery services, to ensure timely scheduling and order fulfillment.

## Security

We implement reasonable measures to protect personal data from unauthorized access, loss, or misuse.

## Customer Rights

Depending on their location, customers may have the right to access, update, or request the deletion of their personal data. To exercise these rights, they can contact us at support@getcho.app.

## Updates to this Policy

This policy may be updated periodically. Significant changes will be communicated through updates on this page or other appropriate channels.

## Contact Us

If you have questions about this policy or need assistance with your data, please contact us at support@getcho.app.

# Authors

We run deliveries every day and write about what we learn doing it. Here's who writes what.

- Jack Considine
  CEO, Getcho

Jack Considine is a co-founder and CEO of Getcho, a delivery orchestration platform for retailers, 3PLs and local brands, headquartered in New York and backed by Y Combinator and Pioneer Fund. He spends most of his time with merchants deciding whether to run distribution themselves or hand it to a marketplace, and writes about the commercial side of that call: what same-day does to conversion and basket size, what a marketplace costs you in customer data and margin, and how brands compete on speed without building a logistics operation.

- Mike Considine
  CTO, Getcho

Mike Considine is a co-founder and CTO of Getcho, where he builds the platform that quotes every order across the carrier network and routes it to the best fit by vehicle, distance and window — from same-day courier work on DoorDash Drive, Uber Direct, Roadie and Senpex through to box-truck and line-haul freight on Frayt and Warp — then re-dispatches automatically when a carrier rejects or no-shows. He owns the Shopify, POS and WMS integrations, including the zip-level and item-level checkout rules that let one store offer delivery in one city and shipping in another, and the AI that briefs drivers before they arrive and reads pickup and delivery photos for mismatches.

- Evandro Nadal
  COO, Getcho

Evandro Nadal is a co-founder and COO of Getcho, responsible for the deliveries the platform runs every day for retailers, grocery and specialty food stores, wineries and third-party logistics providers. He writes the Delivery Forensics series, reconstructing real delivery failures from the evidence — proof-of-delivery photos scored against the address, driver location trails, notification logs — and the operational work behind it: catching a wrong-door drop while the driver is still there, filing and winning the claim mid-delivery, and the address data that stops the same failure twice.

## How to Getcho Academy Sports for same day delivery

Getcho offers an efficient way to buy online and have your items delivered from the store on the same day. Our service is designed for those who prefer the convenience of online shopping combined with the immediacy of store pickup. By choosing Getcho, you can have your Academy Sports purchases delivered from the store directly to your doorstep, combining the best of both worlds: online shopping and immediate access to your items.

### Place your Academy Sports curbside / in-store pickup order

- Visit the Academy Sports website and search for products you’d like to purchase.

- Click on the products you’re interested in and select “Store Pickup.” If you haven’t selected it yet, you will need to search for a store. Use the link on the right panel, input your zip code to find a store near you, and then select it by clicking “Select Store.”

- When viewing an item, you will see options for “Home Delivery” as well as “Store Pick Up.” Select “Store Pick Up”. Note: If you like you can switch to a store with a closer pickup date by clicking “Change Store” and typing in your zip code.

- Now add the item to your cart and proceed to checkout. Once you type in your email, make sure you have selected “Pick Up Today.”

- Feel free to keep the “Who is picking up this order” as “Me” and keep “In-Store” selected.

- Finalize your purchase, and you will receive a confirmation email.

- Important: Once your item is ready, you will receive a ‘order is ready for pickup’ email with all the details. Keep this for the courier.

### Download Getcho

Now it’s time to download the Getcho app from the App Store or the Play Store and create a free account if you haven’t already done so.

### Input your pickup details

- Store address : Ensure you enter the correct Academy Sports location address. Start typing Academy Sports, and you’ll be able to see the locations near you.

- Name on order : Enter the name you used for the order.

- Phone number : Provide your phone number so the driver can contact you if needed.

- Pickup Notes : Include all the information your driver will need to locate your order, such as a screenshot of a barcode, order number, or confirmation code. For example, you might type This is an in-store order under John Smith. Order #00000000. Call if you encounter any issues!

### Input your drop-off details

Now we have to let your Getcho driver know how to reach you. Enter your phone number and any notes that will assist the driver in locating you for the drop-off, such as your house or apartment number, gate code, or any other special instructions.

You can submit your order now or schedule it for later. Getcho will then send you a tracking link to monitor your driver’s progress and text notifications at every step. Feel free to contact your driver and check in anytime!

## Help your driver find your order

Once your driver is on the way, you just have one more step: send your driver a screenshot of the order confirmation email you received.

That’s it! Your driver will pick up your Academy Sports order and deliver it right to you. Enjoy the time you saved by using Getcho.

# Austin Print Delivery with Getcho

You may know you can use Getcho to instantly send things to people -- like food, documents, supplies, tools etc. And you might know you can use Getcho to pick up your curbside orders from virtually any brick-and-mortar -- like Nordstrom , REI , and The Home Depot to name a few. You might even know that you can use Getcho to grab your takeout food orders .

But did you know Getcho has made owning a printer in Austin virtually unnecessary?

## Print Delivery

With our Print Delivery program, you can email support@getcho.app a PDF document with the subject TO PRINT BLACK AND WHITE or TO PRINT COLOR . We'll reply with an order number and a price-to-print. And then you can use the iOS or Android Getcho app to dispatch a delivery for right then, or schedule for a more convenient time.

Note: for the pick-up address, type & select "the Texas Capitol building".

### Pricing

We'll print at Fedex , The Austin Central Library , or whoever has the lowest rate. Then we'll tack that exact amount onto your delivery bill (with a receipt!). Printing tends to be around 14 cents per page black & white, or 55 cents per page in color. Delivery tends to be between $8 and $15 depending on where you are, but the app will give you an exact quote before you order!

Anything else you'd like to see us move? Let us know at support@getcho.app . We look forward to serving you!

# Getcho books: supporting local booksellers

## Same-day delivery from local bookstores

There are over 2,300 bookstores owned by nearly 1,800 different businesses across the United States. Unfortunately, many people buy their books from Amazon and other giant retailers. It’s just too convenient to shop for books from home.

We’re proud to announce that Getcho now offers a solution for supporting local book sellers without sacrificing any convenience. In fact, you can Getcho most books to your door within a few hours, not days.

## How it works

Getcho is a same-day delivery provider that can transport about anything – takeout-food, curbside orders, and of course, books.

Unlike traditional delivery apps, Getcho doesn’t take any money from retailers or restaurants . Instead customers order deliveries through the Getcho app. Local businesses love making traditional sales while knowing customers have a one-stop solution for delivery.

Bookstores are no different. To get a copy of your next read dropped right at your door, simply:

- Search the web for nearby bookstores (we like DuckDuckGo because they don’t charge the booksellers for your clicks, but Google of course works too).

- Check for your online title over the phone or on the store’s website. Not all indie booksellers have an up-to-date catalog, so we recommend calling.

- Purchase the book; if the seller doesn’t have an online checkout page, then call and tell them you’d like to purchase over the phone. Let them know that you’ll be sending a driver to pick up the book when it’s ready.

- Use the iOS or Android Getcho App to send a driver.

- Make sure the “drop-off name” matches the person who purchased the book so the driver can easily find it.

- If the seller gives you an order ID, add that info in the “pickup notes”.

- You can schedule the delivery for a later time if it’s more convenient for you!

# Early Arrivals: How to Ensure Customers Don’t Show Up Too Soon for BOPIS Orders

Having a hard time with customers placing in-store pickup orders and then arriving before the order is actually ready? We know — it’s disruptive.

If your team hasn’t sent the “It’s ready” email, that means the order hasn’t been pulled and packed yet. An early arrival puts immediate strain on store staff, who feel pressured to step away from other customers to handle an order that isn’t ready.

At that point, the item could still be getting located, transferred from another store, or packed in the back. In other words, you may not even be able to hand off the order. That leaves your team feeling like they’re disappointing the customer — even though nothing went wrong.

## Early arrivals are a common BOPIS pain point

We know a thing or two about early arrivals. We manage one of the top same-day delivery apps on Shopify, and our partners who offer BOPIS regularly vent about this challenge:

- Customers arrive early despite confirmation emails telling them to wait

- Customers show up at the wrong store location

- Some even send Uber drivers on their behalf, adding another layer of confusion

One Getcho partner has gone so far as to turn BOPIS off entirely during busy periods just to give store teams more breathing room.

Think about what that means: the disruption is so significant that this store is willing to forgo an entire segment of customers — and the revenue that comes with them — simply because it’s easier.

## So what can you do?

If you’re reading this, you’re likely already fulfilling orders as fast as you can. Speed alone isn’t the issue. The real opportunity is controlling the process flow.

## Control the process by offering courier delivery

In general, BOPIS customers are looking for the fastest possible way to get an order in their hands. That naturally selects for urgency. They’re even willing to handle part of the fulfillment themselves by driving to the store.

That’s the key tradeoff: when customers do part of the delivery, your store gives up some control over timing and execution.

The antidote is simple — offer the fastest possible delivery option and keep ownership of the process. In practice, that means offering courier delivery alongside BOPIS.

Courier delivery (also known as same-day or local delivery) is operationally very similar to BOPIS. The store receives the order, pulls and packs it, and marks it ready. The difference is that the Getcho driver network subscribes to “order ready” updates instead of the customer — which guarantees that no one shows up early.

Getcho Courier Delivery also supports pickups from any store location, making it more resilient to inventory imbalances across stores.

## More context = fewer early arrivals

Back to BOPIS specifically: we’ve found that providing clearer order context goes a long way toward preventing early arrivals.

If a customer only sees “Your order is not ready yet,” they may assume it just needs to be pulled from a shelf. I can do that myself , they think.

But if they see messages like “Your cart is being consolidated” or “Your order is being transferred to the store,” they’re far more likely to understand two things:

- Your team is actively working on it, and

- There’s a more complex process happening behind the scenes.

That added transparency builds patience — and keeps customers from showing up before you’re ready.

Many businesses already rely on popular services like DoorDash, Uber, or Roadie to handle their local deliveries. These platforms provide great courier networks and accessibility, but for some businesses, managing deliveries with them can be overwhelming.

When something goes wrong, timely resolutions are crucial. Without quick, reliable support, errors like lost packages or incorrect drop-offs result in high costs for returns and frustrated customers.

Managing delivery operations means constant communication with couriers and customers, often requiring businesses to dedicate significant time and resources. Some hire full-time staff to oversee these tasks, adding to operational costs.

Without active management, it’s easy for things to go wrong: unclear instructions, mixed-up orders, or missed delivery windows. These errors not only cost time and money but also risk losing customer trust.

The Salvation Army has two Manhattan locations: 175 East 125th Street and 540 Lenox Avenue. They take clothes, hats, gloves, books, and household items. To find more locations, you can search on their site here .

Grand Central Neighborhood Social Services Corp . on 120 East 32nd Street accepts clothes, shoes, toiletries, and non-perishable items. ### Brooklyn, New York

If you live in Brooklyn, you can drop off more than just clothing and books using Getcho. Electronics, silver, purses, and sheets are just a few items that Getcho’s reliable network of couriers is ready to pick up and deliver at the following stores.

# Built for Shopify: The Same-Day Delivery App Shopify Trusts

Getcho is Built for Shopify certified — the highest tier of Shopify’s app standards. For Shopify merchants evaluating a delivery app, the badge is a shortcut for trust: Shopify itself has vetted the app for performance, security, ease of use, and measurable merchant value.

If you run a Shopify store and you’re looking for a same-day delivery app you can actually rely on, Getcho now carries the badge for it.

## What “Built for Shopify” actually means

Built for Shopify is Shopify’s way of vouching for an app. To earn the badge, an app has to clear Shopify’s bar across several dimensions:

- Performance — loads fast, doesn’t slow down the merchant admin, and uses modern best practices.

- Security & privacy — handles merchant and customer data correctly, with proper OAuth scopes, webhook configuration, and data protection.

- Ease of use — follows Shopify’s UX guidelines, uses Polaris components, and integrates cleanly into the native admin.

- Merchant value — real installs, real reviews, and measurable results for the merchants who use it.

Apps that earn the badge also get better visibility in the Shopify App Store , additional trust signals during discovery, and priority placement in search results.

## Why merchants should care

If you’re a Shopify merchant evaluating delivery apps, the Built for Shopify badge is a shortcut. Specifically, it tells you four things:

- The app won’t slow your store down. Getcho has been benchmarked against Shopify’s performance standards. You can install it without worrying about checkout speed or admin load times.

- Your data is handled correctly. Shopify has reviewed our data handling, webhook configuration, and OAuth scopes. We don’t ask for permissions we don’t need.

- The app feels native. Getcho lives inside your Shopify admin the way a first-party feature would. No clunky iframes, no separate dashboards for simple tasks.

- Real merchants are getting value. Built for Shopify requires verified merchant reviews and a track record of solving real operational problems — not just installs.

## What Getcho does for Shopify stores

For context — if you’re new to Getcho — we turn your Shopify store into a same-day delivery operation:

- Automatic order sync. Every eligible Shopify order flows into Getcho in real time. No CSVs, no copy-pasting addresses.

- Multi-location routing. Getcho reads your Shopify locations and inventory. Orders automatically route from the nearest store with stock.

- Auto-dispatch on fulfillment. When you mark an order fulfilled in Shopify, a driver is dispatched automatically — matched by vehicle size, timing, and distance.

- Branded tracking pages. Your customers see your brand on tracking pages, SMS, and email — not a generic courier logo.

- Shopify POS support. Dispatch deliveries from in-store purchases just as easily as online orders.

- Returns, rentals, and inventory transfers . Same courier network handles pickups, round-trip rentals, and store-to-store transfers.

And because Getcho connects to a multi-fleet network — Roadie, Uber, DoorDash, Frayt, Bungii, and more — you’re not locked into a single courier. Orders route to the best available fleet in real time, so reliability doesn’t depend on one provider’s coverage that day.

## How to install

If you’re on Shopify and you want to try Getcho:

- Visit the Getcho Same-Day Delivery app on the Shopify App Store .

- Click install — no developer, no API keys, no long onboarding.

- Configure your delivery zones, cutoff times, and branding.

- Start dispatching.

Most stores are live in minutes. If you want to talk through a custom setup first, our team is happy to help.

## Same-Day Delivery, Shopify-Certified

Install Getcho from the Shopify App Store and start offering same-day delivery in minutes — no developer required.
Install on Shopify →

What does Built for Shopify mean? Built for Shopify is Shopify’s highest tier of app certification. It’s reserved for apps that meet Shopify’s standards across performance, security, ease of use, and measurable merchant value. Only a small subset of apps on the Shopify App Store earn the badge.

Why should a Shopify merchant care about the Built for Shopify badge? The badge is a shortcut for trust. It signals that the app won’t slow down your store, that Shopify has reviewed how it handles data and permissions, that it integrates natively with the Shopify admin, and that it’s producing real value for real merchants.

How is Getcho different from other Shopify delivery apps? Getcho is a multi-fleet delivery orchestration platform — orders route to the best available fleet in real time instead of locking you into a single courier. # A Deep Dive Into Getcho’s Unique Delivery Process

Getcho goes beyond simply offering same-day delivery. We manage every step of the process with precision and care, providing businesses and their customers with an unparalleled delivery experience. Here’s how our platform works and why it stands out.

## Step 1: Verify Order Details

Our process starts by ensuring every order is accurate and ready for a smooth delivery:

- Address Confirmation : We verify both pickup and drop-off addresses to avoid errors.

- Delivery Notes Review : If special instructions are included (e.g., “Leave with doorman”), we ensure they match the addresses provided.

- Historical Notes Check : We cross-reference past deliveries to flag potential issues.

## Step 2: Select the Ideal Delivery Fleet

We choose the best courier network for each delivery based on speed, cost, and payload.

- Fleet Optimization : Our technology evaluates courier options to balance efficiency and affordability.

- Trusted Partnerships : We work with vetted third-party fleets to ensure reliability.

## Step 3: Coordinate Pickup

Clear communication at pickup ensures no delays or confusion:

- Courier Instructions : Pickup details and any specific business requirements are shared with the courier.

- Order Readiness Verification : We integrate with retailers’ systems to confirm orders are prepared.

- ID Verification : If required, we ensure secure pickups through ID checks.

## Step 4: Oversee Drop-Off

We coordinate the final stage of delivery with precision:

- Recipient Availability : Getcho confirms availability or coordinates with a doorman for secure drop-offs.

- Delivery Preferences : ETAs and special instructions (e.g., discreet packaging for gifts) are followed to ensure satisfaction.

## Step 5: Actively Manage Orders in Real-Time

Delivery management doesn’t stop once the package is on the road. Getcho actively tracks and resolves issues as they arise:

- Real-Time Updates : Businesses and customers are notified at every stage.

- Issue Resolution : We quickly address delays, address mismatches, or unexpected courier issues.

- Loss Prevention : Our system calculates a “risk score” to predict and prevent potential delivery problems.

## Step 6: Confirm Delivery

The process ends with a thorough confirmation:

- Photo Verification : Confirmation with photos and GPS data is sent to both the business and the customer.

- Follow-Up Reporting : Delivery details are included in weekly business reports, keeping you informed and in control.

## Why Local Businesses Choose Getcho

- Active Order Management : We handle scheduling, communication, and risk management, ensuring each delivery is seamless.

- Third-Party Courier Integration : No need to maintain an in-house fleet—our network of couriers has you covered.

- Enhanced Customer Experience : A fully managed delivery experience that improves customer satisfaction and loyalty.

- Cost Savings : Businesses save on labor and logistics costs while offering premium service.

## Discover the Getcho Difference

Ready to simplify your logistics and delight your customers?
