## FAQ (full answers)

### What is Getcho?

Getcho ("get-cho") is a delivery platform designed for businesses. We simplify local deliveries, pickups, and returns using AI-powered tools to reduce errors, improve reliability, and scale operations—helping businesses meet customer expectations and grow without adding staff.

### How do I get started?

Request a demo at getcho.app. From there, we will set up your business dashboard and integrate your Shopify store or other systems as needed.

### What platforms does Getcho integrate with?

We integrate with Shopify, Shopify POS (including POS Lite via our native POS Extension), RICS Software, Packiyo, CleanCloud, Slack, WhatsApp, and custom APIs. Whatever your business needs, we can build it. Schedule a demo to discuss your specific integration requirements.

### Does Getcho work inside Shopify POS?

Yes. The Getcho Shopify POS Extension embeds the same-day delivery queue directly in Shopify POS — including POS Lite, with no POS Pro subscription required. Your team sees a tabbed task view (Need to Pack, On Pickup, On Dropoff, Delivered), scans items with the POS camera for barcode verification, and dispatches a courier in one tap. Slack or SMS pings when a new order hits the queue.

### How does Getcho's AI help my business?

Our AI manages the complex logistics so you don't have to—from smart fleet matching to automatic issue resolution. We handle all the operational details, allowing you to focus on growing your business.

### How does Getcho scale with my business?

Getcho helps businesses handle high delivery volumes by enabling one manager to oversee many deliveries at once, cutting costs and improving efficiency.

### What scale of deliveries can Getcho handle?

Getcho can handle very large delivery volumes. We've successfully processed over 100 orders in under 2 hours for clients. Our AI-powered platform scales to meet your business needs, whether you're doing 10 deliveries a day or 1,000+.

### What types of businesses use Getcho?

Getcho is trusted by a wide range of businesses, including wineries managing direct-to-consumer deliveries, high-end produce and specialty food businesses, stores supporting store-to-store or warehouse-to-store transfers, high-end retailers offering same-day or scheduled deliveries, clothing boutiques, florists and gift shops, rental businesses managing drop-offs and pickups, and SMBs looking to scale logistics without increasing headcount.

### What kind of analytics does Getcho provide?

We provide comprehensive analytics including cart conversion data, customer sentiment analysis, and detailed delivery metrics. These insights help you optimize your delivery operations and improve customer satisfaction.

### How much does a delivery cost?

Pricing is flexible based on your business needs. We offer subscription plans, per-delivery pricing, and custom pricing for larger volumes. Contact us for more details.

### Does Getcho offer white-label delivery tracking?

Yes, you can custom-brand all tracking experiences to match your business. Your customers get a consistent, branded experience regardless of which fleet delivers their order. Branding is optional and fully configurable.

### Can I manage multiple locations with Getcho?

Yes, Getcho supports multi-location businesses by centralizing delivery management, enabling seamless coordination between stores, warehouses, and customers.

### Can I customize delivery zones and hours?

Yes, you can configure custom delivery zones by zip code or radius from your store locations. You can also set specific delivery hours and days to match your business operations.

### Does Getcho support custom integrations?

Yes, we can build custom integrations to meet your business needs. As developers at heart, we're ready to create tailored solutions—just reach out to request custom integrations.

### Does Getcho support bulk order uploads?

Yes, we allow bulk order imports to streamline large-scale delivery scheduling and processing.

### What areas does Getcho service?

Getcho delivers nationwide across the United States. Whether you are in a major metro area or a smaller market, our multi-fleet network provides coverage wherever your customers are.

### What can my business send with Getcho?

Businesses use Getcho to deliver items like retail orders, returns, rental equipment, and more. We support everything from sedans for a few items to box trucks with lift gates—our AI finds the best fleet for each delivery. Contact us if you have special delivery requirements.

### Can Getcho handle time-sensitive or perishable deliveries?

Yes. Short transit times are the best protection for perishable items — same-day local delivery means your products spend minutes in transit, not days. Pair that with your own packaging and Getcho handles the rest. Contact us to discuss your specific requirements.

### Can I track my delivery?

Yes, all deliveries include real-time tracking, audit logs, and proof-of-delivery photos to ensure transparency and reliability. Premium plans offer a custom tracking link and allow multiple recipients to receive updates and notifications on orders.

### What types of notifications do my customers receive?

Customers receive real-time updates via SMS or email, including order confirmations, delivery tracking, and proof-of-delivery notifications.

### What insurance options are available?

Insurance coverage is available for your deliveries. Options range from standard coverage to custom policies for higher-value items based on your average cargo value. Contact us to discuss the right coverage for your business.

### What happens if a delivery goes wrong?

We use AI-powered follow-ups to resolve issues quickly, reducing claims and improving customer satisfaction. In cases where issues cannot be resolved immediately, insurance coverage options are available to protect your shipments.

### Can Getcho handle returns?

Yes, Getcho supports local returns, including same-day return pickups. We also offer a Shopify integration that streamlines the return process for both regular purchases and rental items.

### Does Getcho support rentals?

Yes, we support businesses offering rentals by managing deliveries and pickups for rental items. Customers can schedule flexible delivery and return times to meet their needs.

### Does Getcho support round trips?

Yes. Getcho supports same-day round trips, where a single driver completes the delivery and returns to your store on the same run — bringing back signed paperwork, reusable totes and containers, or equipment. A driver can also make a stop and come back to where they started, all in one dispatched job.

### Can Getcho handle recurring deliveries?

Yes, we support recurring and subscription-based deliveries. We save customer profiles and delivery preferences, so the experience is consistent—customers don't have to repeat their instructions with each delivery.

### Can I schedule a delivery in advance?

Yes, deliveries can be scheduled up to 7 days in advance, ensuring flexibility and convenience.

### How quickly can Getcho deliver a package?

Deliveries are typically dispatched within minutes. Multi-signal dispatch sends your order to multiple fleets simultaneously — the first available driver wins. Most orders are completed within hours.

### How will I know if something goes wrong with a pickup — like a driver grabbing the wrong order?

You'll be notified, fast. Getcho actively monitors every delivery and surfaces issues like a mismatched or missed pickup so your team can send a replacement right away. You choose how you hear about it — Slack, SMS, or email — and notifications are fully configurable. For most stores we also recommend barcode verification at pickup, which scans each item against the order so the wrong package is caught before it ever leaves the door. And when it's a no-harm mix-up (a driver marks picked up without actually grabbing the order, or returns unnecessarily), Getcho will often redispatch on the store's behalf automatically — frequently before anyone has to lift a finger. We stay very hands-on with our store teams.

### What happens after I send an order to Getcho via API, and how fast is it assigned to a driver?

For all intents and purposes, immediately. Once a quote is accepted, the order enters dispatch. Our most common workflow assigns the cheapest available carrier, and in that case the order is assigned to a delivery partner right away. If speed is what you care about most, we can optimize for the fastest available driver instead — dispatch is modular, so we're happy to chat about what fits your operation. For orders scheduled in advance, the same applies as the delivery window approaches, and scheduled orders can be canceled for free up until dispatch.

### Can I update an order after it has been sent to Getcho but before a driver is assigned?

Yes — this happens all the time, and we use APIs to update orders on the fly. Before a driver is assigned, order details can be modified directly. Even after a driver has picked up, reach out and we can usually still get updated instructions where they need to go.

### If a driver is already assigned and I need to cancel because the order isn't ready, how does that work — and who covers the cost?

It depends on timing. If a driver is already en route, the fleet usually charges a cancellation fee, which is passed along. If the cancellation was due to a Getcho dispatch mistake, Getcho may absorb that fee. And if "not ready yet" is something your store runs into regularly, let's talk — we've got solutions, including dispatching only once an order is actually packed rather than purely around the scheduled window.

## FAQ (full answers)

### What is Getcho?

Getcho ("get-cho") is a delivery platform designed for businesses. We simplify local deliveries, pickups, and returns using AI-powered tools to reduce errors, improve reliability, and scale operations—helping businesses meet customer expectations and grow without adding staff.

### How do I get started?

Request a demo at getcho.app. From there, we will set up your business dashboard and integrate your Shopify store or other systems as needed.

### What platforms does Getcho integrate with?

We integrate with Shopify, Shopify POS (including POS Lite via our native POS Extension), RICS Software, Packiyo, CleanCloud, Slack, WhatsApp, and custom APIs. Whatever your business needs, we can build it. Schedule a demo to discuss your specific integration requirements.

### Does Getcho work inside Shopify POS?

Yes. The Getcho Shopify POS Extension embeds the same-day delivery queue directly in Shopify POS — including POS Lite, with no POS Pro subscription required. Your team sees a tabbed task view (Need to Pack, On Pickup, On Dropoff, Delivered), scans items with the POS camera for barcode verification, and dispatches a courier in one tap. Slack or SMS pings when a new order hits the queue.

### How does Getcho's AI help my business?

Our AI manages the complex logistics so you don't have to—from smart fleet matching to automatic issue resolution. We handle all the operational details, allowing you to focus on growing your business.

### How does Getcho scale with my business?

Getcho helps businesses handle high delivery volumes by enabling one manager to oversee many deliveries at once, cutting costs and improving efficiency.

### What scale of deliveries can Getcho handle?

Getcho can handle very large delivery volumes. We've successfully processed over 100 orders in under 2 hours for clients. Our AI-powered platform scales to meet your business needs, whether you're doing 10 deliveries a day or 1,000+.

### What types of businesses use Getcho?

Getcho is trusted by a wide range of businesses, including wineries managing direct-to-consumer deliveries, high-end produce and specialty food businesses, stores supporting store-to-store or warehouse-to-store transfers, high-end retailers offering same-day or scheduled deliveries, clothing boutiques, florists and gift shops, rental businesses managing drop-offs and pickups, and SMBs looking to scale logistics without increasing headcount.

### What kind of analytics does Getcho provide?

We provide comprehensive analytics including cart conversion data, customer sentiment analysis, and detailed delivery metrics. These insights help you optimize your delivery operations and improve customer satisfaction.

### How much does a delivery cost?

Pricing is flexible based on your business needs. We offer subscription plans, per-delivery pricing, and custom pricing for larger volumes. Contact us for more details.

### Does Getcho offer white-label delivery tracking?

Yes, you can custom-brand all tracking experiences to match your business. Your customers get a consistent, branded experience regardless of which fleet delivers their order. Branding is optional and fully configurable.

### Can I manage multiple locations with Getcho?

Yes, Getcho supports multi-location businesses by centralizing delivery management, enabling seamless coordination between stores, warehouses, and customers.

### Can I customize delivery zones and hours?

Yes, you can configure custom delivery zones by zip code or radius from your store locations. You can also set specific delivery hours and days to match your business operations.

### Does Getcho support custom integrations?

Yes, we can build custom integrations to meet your business needs. As developers at heart, we're ready to create tailored solutions—just reach out to request custom integrations.

### Does Getcho support bulk order uploads?

Yes, we allow bulk order imports to streamline large-scale delivery scheduling and processing.

### What areas does Getcho service?

Getcho delivers nationwide across the United States. Whether you are in a major metro area or a smaller market, our multi-fleet network provides coverage wherever your customers are.

### What can my business send with Getcho?

Businesses use Getcho to deliver items like retail orders, returns, rental equipment, and more. We support everything from sedans for a few items to box trucks with lift gates—our AI finds the best fleet for each delivery. Contact us if you have special delivery requirements.

### Can Getcho handle time-sensitive or perishable deliveries?

Yes. Short transit times are the best protection for perishable items — same-day local delivery means your products spend minutes in transit, not days. Pair that with your own packaging and Getcho handles the rest. Contact us to discuss your specific requirements.

### Can I track my delivery?

Yes, all deliveries include real-time tracking, audit logs, and proof-of-delivery photos to ensure transparency and reliability. Premium plans offer a custom tracking link and allow multiple recipients to receive updates and notifications on orders.

### What types of notifications do my customers receive?

Customers receive real-time updates via SMS or email, including order confirmations, delivery tracking, and proof-of-delivery notifications.

### What insurance options are available?

Insurance coverage is available for your deliveries. Options range from standard coverage to custom policies for higher-value items based on your average cargo value. Contact us to discuss the right coverage for your business.

### What happens if a delivery goes wrong?

We use AI-powered follow-ups to resolve issues quickly, reducing claims and improving customer satisfaction. In cases where issues cannot be resolved immediately, insurance coverage options are available to protect your shipments.

### Can Getcho handle returns?

Yes, Getcho supports local returns, including same-day return pickups. We also offer a Shopify integration that streamlines the return process for both regular purchases and rental items.

### Does Getcho support rentals?

Yes, we support businesses offering rentals by managing deliveries and pickups for rental items. Customers can schedule flexible delivery and return times to meet their needs.

### Does Getcho support round trips?

Yes. Getcho supports same-day round trips, where a single driver completes the delivery and returns to your store on the same run — bringing back signed paperwork, reusable totes and containers, or equipment. A driver can also make a stop and come back to where they started, all in one dispatched job.

### Can Getcho handle recurring deliveries?

Yes, we support recurring and subscription-based deliveries. We save customer profiles and delivery preferences, so the experience is consistent—customers don't have to repeat their instructions with each delivery.

### Can I schedule a delivery in advance?

Yes, deliveries can be scheduled up to 7 days in advance, ensuring flexibility and convenience.

### How quickly can Getcho deliver a package?

Deliveries are typically dispatched within minutes. Multi-signal dispatch sends your order to multiple fleets simultaneously — the first available driver wins. Most orders are completed within hours.

### How will I know if something goes wrong with a pickup — like a driver grabbing the wrong order?

You'll be notified, fast. Getcho actively monitors every delivery and surfaces issues like a mismatched or missed pickup so your team can send a replacement right away. You choose how you hear about it — Slack, SMS, or email — and notifications are fully configurable. For most stores we also recommend barcode verification at pickup, which scans each item against the order so the wrong package is caught before it ever leaves the door. And when it's a no-harm mix-up (a driver marks picked up without actually grabbing the order, or returns unnecessarily), Getcho will often redispatch on the store's behalf automatically — frequently before anyone has to lift a finger. We stay very hands-on with our store teams.

### What happens after I send an order to Getcho via API, and how fast is it assigned to a driver?

For all intents and purposes, immediately. Once a quote is accepted, the order enters dispatch. Our most common workflow assigns the cheapest available carrier, and in that case the order is assigned to a delivery partner right away. If speed is what you care about most, we can optimize for the fastest available driver instead — dispatch is modular, so we're happy to chat about what fits your operation. For orders scheduled in advance, the same applies as the delivery window approaches, and scheduled orders can be canceled for free up until dispatch.

### Can I update an order after it has been sent to Getcho but before a driver is assigned?

Yes — this happens all the time, and we use APIs to update orders on the fly. Before a driver is assigned, order details can be modified directly. Even after a driver has picked up, reach out and we can usually still get updated instructions where they need to go.

### If a driver is already assigned and I need to cancel because the order isn't ready, how does that work — and who covers the cost?

It depends on timing. If a driver is already en route, the fleet usually charges a cancellation fee, which is passed along. If the cancellation was due to a Getcho dispatch mistake, Getcho may absorb that fee. And if "not ready yet" is something your store runs into regularly, let's talk — we've got solutions, including dispatching only once an order is actually packed rather than purely around the scheduled window.

## FAQ (full answers)

### What is Getcho?

Getcho ("get-cho") is a delivery platform designed for businesses. We simplify local deliveries, pickups, and returns using AI-powered tools to reduce errors, improve reliability, and scale operations—helping businesses meet customer expectations and grow without adding staff.

### How do I get started?

Request a demo at getcho.app. From there, we will set up your business dashboard and integrate your Shopify store or other systems as needed.

### What platforms does Getcho integrate with?

We integrate with Shopify, Shopify POS (including POS Lite via our native POS Extension), RICS Software, Packiyo, CleanCloud, Slack, WhatsApp, and custom APIs. Whatever your business needs, we can build it. Schedule a demo to discuss your specific integration requirements.

### Does Getcho work inside Shopify POS?

Yes. The Getcho Shopify POS Extension embeds the same-day delivery queue directly in Shopify POS — including POS Lite, with no POS Pro subscription required. Your team sees a tabbed task view (Need to Pack, On Pickup, On Dropoff, Delivered), scans items with the POS camera for barcode verification, and dispatches a courier in one tap. Slack or SMS pings when a new order hits the queue.

### How does Getcho's AI help my business?

Our AI manages the complex logistics so you don't have to—from smart fleet matching to automatic issue resolution. We handle all the operational details, allowing you to focus on growing your business.

### How does Getcho scale with my business?

Getcho helps businesses handle high delivery volumes by enabling one manager to oversee many deliveries at once, cutting costs and improving efficiency.

### What scale of deliveries can Getcho handle?

Getcho can handle very large delivery volumes. We've successfully processed over 100 orders in under 2 hours for clients. Our AI-powered platform scales to meet your business needs, whether you're doing 10 deliveries a day or 1,000+.

### What types of businesses use Getcho?

Getcho is trusted by a wide range of businesses, including wineries managing direct-to-consumer deliveries, high-end produce and specialty food businesses, stores supporting store-to-store or warehouse-to-store transfers, high-end retailers offering same-day or scheduled deliveries, clothing boutiques, florists and gift shops, rental businesses managing drop-offs and pickups, and SMBs looking to scale logistics without increasing headcount.

### What kind of analytics does Getcho provide?

We provide comprehensive analytics including cart conversion data, customer sentiment analysis, and detailed delivery metrics. These insights help you optimize your delivery operations and improve customer satisfaction.

### How much does a delivery cost?

Pricing is flexible based on your business needs. We offer subscription plans, per-delivery pricing, and custom pricing for larger volumes. Contact us for more details.

### Does Getcho offer white-label delivery tracking?

Yes, you can custom-brand all tracking experiences to match your business. Your customers get a consistent, branded experience regardless of which fleet delivers their order. Branding is optional and fully configurable.

### Can I manage multiple locations with Getcho?

Yes, Getcho supports multi-location businesses by centralizing delivery management, enabling seamless coordination between stores, warehouses, and customers.

### Can I customize delivery zones and hours?

Yes, you can configure custom delivery zones by zip code or radius from your store locations. You can also set specific delivery hours and days to match your business operations.

### Does Getcho support custom integrations?

Yes, we can build custom integrations to meet your business needs. As developers at heart, we're ready to create tailored solutions—just reach out to request custom integrations.

### Does Getcho support bulk order uploads?

Yes, we allow bulk order imports to streamline large-scale delivery scheduling and processing.

### What areas does Getcho service?

Getcho delivers nationwide across the United States. Whether you are in a major metro area or a smaller market, our multi-fleet network provides coverage wherever your customers are.

### What can my business send with Getcho?

Businesses use Getcho to deliver items like retail orders, returns, rental equipment, and more. We support everything from sedans for a few items to box trucks with lift gates—our AI finds the best fleet for each delivery. Contact us if you have special delivery requirements.

### Can Getcho handle time-sensitive or perishable deliveries?

Yes. Short transit times are the best protection for perishable items — same-day local delivery means your products spend minutes in transit, not days. Pair that with your own packaging and Getcho handles the rest. Contact us to discuss your specific requirements.

### Can I track my delivery?

Yes, all deliveries include real-time tracking, audit logs, and proof-of-delivery photos to ensure transparency and reliability. Premium plans offer a custom tracking link and allow multiple recipients to receive updates and notifications on orders.

### What types of notifications do my customers receive?

Customers receive real-time updates via SMS or email, including order confirmations, delivery tracking, and proof-of-delivery notifications.

### What insurance options are available?

Insurance coverage is available for your deliveries. Options range from standard coverage to custom policies for higher-value items based on your average cargo value. Contact us to discuss the right coverage for your business.

### What happens if a delivery goes wrong?

We use AI-powered follow-ups to resolve issues quickly, reducing claims and improving customer satisfaction. In cases where issues cannot be resolved immediately, insurance coverage options are available to protect your shipments.

### Can Getcho handle returns?

Yes, Getcho supports local returns, including same-day return pickups. We also offer a Shopify integration that streamlines the return process for both regular purchases and rental items.

### Does Getcho support rentals?

Yes, we support businesses offering rentals by managing deliveries and pickups for rental items. Customers can schedule flexible delivery and return times to meet their needs.

### Does Getcho support round trips?

Yes. Getcho supports same-day round trips, where a single driver completes the delivery and returns to your store on the same run — bringing back signed paperwork, reusable totes and containers, or equipment. A driver can also make a stop and come back to where they started, all in one dispatched job.

### Can Getcho handle recurring deliveries?

Yes, we support recurring and subscription-based deliveries. We save customer profiles and delivery preferences, so the experience is consistent—customers don't have to repeat their instructions with each delivery.

### Can I schedule a delivery in advance?

Yes, deliveries can be scheduled up to 7 days in advance, ensuring flexibility and convenience.

### How quickly can Getcho deliver a package?

Deliveries are typically dispatched within minutes. Multi-signal dispatch sends your order to multiple fleets simultaneously — the first available driver wins. Most orders are completed within hours.

### How will I know if something goes wrong with a pickup — like a driver grabbing the wrong order?

You'll be notified, fast. Getcho actively monitors every delivery and surfaces issues like a mismatched or missed pickup so your team can send a replacement right away. You choose how you hear about it — Slack, SMS, or email — and notifications are fully configurable. For most stores we also recommend barcode verification at pickup, which scans each item against the order so the wrong package is caught before it ever leaves the door. And when it's a no-harm mix-up (a driver marks picked up without actually grabbing the order, or returns unnecessarily), Getcho will often redispatch on the store's behalf automatically — frequently before anyone has to lift a finger. We stay very hands-on with our store teams.

### What happens after I send an order to Getcho via API, and how fast is it assigned to a driver?

For all intents and purposes, immediately. Once a quote is accepted, the order enters dispatch. Our most common workflow assigns the cheapest available carrier, and in that case the order is assigned to a delivery partner right away. If speed is what you care about most, we can optimize for the fastest available driver instead — dispatch is modular, so we're happy to chat about what fits your operation. For orders scheduled in advance, the same applies as the delivery window approaches, and scheduled orders can be canceled for free up until dispatch.

### Can I update an order after it has been sent to Getcho but before a driver is assigned?

Yes — this happens all the time, and we use APIs to update orders on the fly. Before a driver is assigned, order details can be modified directly. Even after a driver has picked up, reach out and we can usually still get updated instructions where they need to go.

### If a driver is already assigned and I need to cancel because the order isn't ready, how does that work — and who covers the cost?

It depends on timing. If a driver is already en route, the fleet usually charges a cancellation fee, which is passed along. If the cancellation was due to a Getcho dispatch mistake, Getcho may absorb that fee. And if "not ready yet" is something your store runs into regularly, let's talk — we've got solutions, including dispatching only once an order is actually packed rather than purely around the scheduled window.

## FAQ (full answers)

### What is Getcho?

Getcho ("get-cho") is a delivery platform designed for businesses. We simplify local deliveries, pickups, and returns using AI-powered tools to reduce errors, improve reliability, and scale operations—helping businesses meet customer expectations and grow without adding staff.

### How do I get started?

Request a demo at getcho.app. From there, we will set up your business dashboard and integrate your Shopify store or other systems as needed.

### What platforms does Getcho integrate with?

We integrate with Shopify, Shopify POS (including POS Lite via our native POS Extension), RICS Software, Packiyo, CleanCloud, Slack, WhatsApp, and custom APIs. Whatever your business needs, we can build it. Schedule a demo to discuss your specific integration requirements.

### Does Getcho work inside Shopify POS?

Yes. The Getcho Shopify POS Extension embeds the same-day delivery queue directly in Shopify POS — including POS Lite, with no POS Pro subscription required. Your team sees a tabbed task view (Need to Pack, On Pickup, On Dropoff, Delivered), scans items with the POS camera for barcode verification, and dispatches a courier in one tap. Slack or SMS pings when a new order hits the queue.

### How does Getcho's AI help my business?

Our AI manages the complex logistics so you don't have to—from smart fleet matching to automatic issue resolution. We handle all the operational details, allowing you to focus on growing your business.

### How does Getcho scale with my business?

Getcho helps businesses handle high delivery volumes by enabling one manager to oversee many deliveries at once, cutting costs and improving efficiency.

### What scale of deliveries can Getcho handle?

Getcho can handle very large delivery volumes. We've successfully processed over 100 orders in under 2 hours for clients. Our AI-powered platform scales to meet your business needs, whether you're doing 10 deliveries a day or 1,000+.

### What types of businesses use Getcho?

Getcho is trusted by a wide range of businesses, including wineries managing direct-to-consumer deliveries, high-end produce and specialty food businesses, stores supporting store-to-store or warehouse-to-store transfers, high-end retailers offering same-day or scheduled deliveries, clothing boutiques, florists and gift shops, rental businesses managing drop-offs and pickups, and SMBs looking to scale logistics without increasing headcount.

### What kind of analytics does Getcho provide?

We provide comprehensive analytics including cart conversion data, customer sentiment analysis, and detailed delivery metrics. These insights help you optimize your delivery operations and improve customer satisfaction.

### How much does a delivery cost?

Pricing is flexible based on your business needs. We offer subscription plans, per-delivery pricing, and custom pricing for larger volumes. Contact us for more details.

### Does Getcho offer white-label delivery tracking?

Yes, you can custom-brand all tracking experiences to match your business. Your customers get a consistent, branded experience regardless of which fleet delivers their order. Branding is optional and fully configurable.

### Can I manage multiple locations with Getcho?

Yes, Getcho supports multi-location businesses by centralizing delivery management, enabling seamless coordination between stores, warehouses, and customers.

### Can I customize delivery zones and hours?

Yes, you can configure custom delivery zones by zip code or radius from your store locations. You can also set specific delivery hours and days to match your business operations.

### Does Getcho support custom integrations?

Yes, we can build custom integrations to meet your business needs. As developers at heart, we're ready to create tailored solutions—just reach out to request custom integrations.

### Does Getcho support bulk order uploads?

Yes, we allow bulk order imports to streamline large-scale delivery scheduling and processing.

### What areas does Getcho service?

Getcho delivers nationwide across the United States. Whether you are in a major metro area or a smaller market, our multi-fleet network provides coverage wherever your customers are.

### What can my business send with Getcho?

Businesses use Getcho to deliver items like retail orders, returns, rental equipment, and more. We support everything from sedans for a few items to box trucks with lift gates—our AI finds the best fleet for each delivery. Contact us if you have special delivery requirements.

### Can Getcho handle time-sensitive or perishable deliveries?

Yes. Short transit times are the best protection for perishable items — same-day local delivery means your products spend minutes in transit, not days. Pair that with your own packaging and Getcho handles the rest. Contact us to discuss your specific requirements.

### Can I track my delivery?

Yes, all deliveries include real-time tracking, audit logs, and proof-of-delivery photos to ensure transparency and reliability. Premium plans offer a custom tracking link and allow multiple recipients to receive updates and notifications on orders.

### What types of notifications do my customers receive?

Customers receive real-time updates via SMS or email, including order confirmations, delivery tracking, and proof-of-delivery notifications.

### What insurance options are available?

Insurance coverage is available for your deliveries. Options range from standard coverage to custom policies for higher-value items based on your average cargo value. Contact us to discuss the right coverage for your business.

### What happens if a delivery goes wrong?

We use AI-powered follow-ups to resolve issues quickly, reducing claims and improving customer satisfaction. In cases where issues cannot be resolved immediately, insurance coverage options are available to protect your shipments.

### Can Getcho handle returns?

Yes, Getcho supports local returns, including same-day return pickups. We also offer a Shopify integration that streamlines the return process for both regular purchases and rental items.

### Does Getcho support rentals?

Yes, we support businesses offering rentals by managing deliveries and pickups for rental items. Customers can schedule flexible delivery and return times to meet their needs.

### Does Getcho support round trips?

Yes. Getcho supports same-day round trips, where a single driver completes the delivery and returns to your store on the same run — bringing back signed paperwork, reusable totes and containers, or equipment. A driver can also make a stop and come back to where they started, all in one dispatched job.

### Can Getcho handle recurring deliveries?

Yes, we support recurring and subscription-based deliveries. We save customer profiles and delivery preferences, so the experience is consistent—customers don't have to repeat their instructions with each delivery.

### Can I schedule a delivery in advance?

Yes, deliveries can be scheduled up to 7 days in advance, ensuring flexibility and convenience.

### How quickly can Getcho deliver a package?

Deliveries are typically dispatched within minutes. Multi-signal dispatch sends your order to multiple fleets simultaneously — the first available driver wins. Most orders are completed within hours.

### How will I know if something goes wrong with a pickup — like a driver grabbing the wrong order?

You'll be notified, fast. Getcho actively monitors every delivery and surfaces issues like a mismatched or missed pickup so your team can send a replacement right away. You choose how you hear about it — Slack, SMS, or email — and notifications are fully configurable. For most stores we also recommend barcode verification at pickup, which scans each item against the order so the wrong package is caught before it ever leaves the door. And when it's a no-harm mix-up (a driver marks picked up without actually grabbing the order, or returns unnecessarily), Getcho will often redispatch on the store's behalf automatically — frequently before anyone has to lift a finger. We stay very hands-on with our store teams.

### What happens after I send an order to Getcho via API, and how fast is it assigned to a driver?

For all intents and purposes, immediately. Once a quote is accepted, the order enters dispatch. Our most common workflow assigns the cheapest available carrier, and in that case the order is assigned to a delivery partner right away. If speed is what you care about most, we can optimize for the fastest available driver instead — dispatch is modular, so we're happy to chat about what fits your operation. For orders scheduled in advance, the same applies as the delivery window approaches, and scheduled orders can be canceled for free up until dispatch.

### Can I update an order after it has been sent to Getcho but before a driver is assigned?

Yes — this happens all the time, and we use APIs to update orders on the fly. Before a driver is assigned, order details can be modified directly. Even after a driver has picked up, reach out and we can usually still get updated instructions where they need to go.

### If a driver is already assigned and I need to cancel because the order isn't ready, how does that work — and who covers the cost?

It depends on timing. If a driver is already en route, the fleet usually charges a cancellation fee, which is passed along. If the cancellation was due to a Getcho dispatch mistake, Getcho may absorb that fee. And if "not ready yet" is something your store runs into regularly, let's talk — we've got solutions, including dispatching only once an order is actually packed rather than purely around the scheduled window.

What Recovery Workflows Does

## Automated remediation across the delivery lifecycle

Most delivery problems follow a predictable pattern — a driver doesn't show, a delivery stalls, an SLA breaches. Recovery Workflows handles each of these without a human in the loop, escalating only when judgment is genuinely required.

Detects SLA breaches in real time Recovery Workflows fires when Watchdog (or any other Getcho signal) confirms a problem — no-show, prolonged stall, missed pickup or delivery window. No more waiting on a customer complaint to find out something went wrong.

Auto-reassigns to a backup fleet When an SLA breach is confirmed, Getcho can pull the driver and re-dispatch the order to a backup fleet automatically. Your customer's delivery keeps moving while your team stays focused on the work that needs them.

Reaches the driver directly When a quick check-in can save the delivery, Recovery Workflows triggers a Getcho voice agent to reach the driver — multilingual, automatic, no dispatcher required. Driver check-ins speed up frozen deliveries by 18 minutes on average.

Smart escalation to your ops team When automation can't fully resolve the issue, the right person gets the right alert — Slack, SMS, WhatsApp, email, or phone. No alert fatigue, no false alarms, no checking dashboards every five minutes.

Driver pool management over time Couriers who repeatedly fail to meet SLAs are flagged out of your eligible driver pool. Recovery Workflows turns one-off incidents into long-term quality improvements — your reliable drivers stay in rotation, the unreliable ones don't.

Full audit trail on every workflow run Every workflow run is logged on the delivery record — what was detected, what action was taken, and the outcome. Useful for auditing, dispute resolution, and post-mortems on what went right or wrong.

Recovery Workflows FAQ

## Common questions about automated delivery issue resolution

Can't find what you're looking for? Reach out to us .
What are Getcho Recovery Workflows? Recovery Workflows are Getcho's automated remediation engine. When a delivery hits a problem — driver no-show, prolonged stall, route deviation, missed window, or any other SLA breach — Recovery Workflows orchestrates the next steps automatically, without a human dispatcher having to glue the pieces together.
How do Recovery Workflows pair with Watchdog? Watchdog is Getcho's real-time monitoring agent — it watches every active delivery and surfaces issues early. Recovery Workflows is what fixes them. When Watchdog (or any other signal) flags a problem, Recovery Workflows takes the next step: contact the driver, ping ops, or pull the driver and re-dispatch to a backup fleet.
What kinds of issues do Recovery Workflows resolve? No-shows, prolonged stalls, repeated route deviations, missed pickup or delivery windows, and confirmed SLA breaches. The engine handles each scenario without human intervention up to the point where a person genuinely needs to make a call.
When does a delivery get auto-reassigned to a different fleet? When Recovery Workflows confirms an SLA breach — for example, a driver is more than X minutes late to pickup or has been stationary too long — Getcho can pull the driver and re-dispatch the delivery to a backup fleet automatically. Underperforming couriers are flagged out of your eligible driver pool over time.
Will my ops team still be alerted? Yes — but only when human judgment is genuinely needed. The whole point of Recovery Workflows is to take noise off your team's plate. When automation can resolve the issue, it does. When it can't, the right person gets pinged via Slack, SMS, WhatsApp, email, or phone.
Does this require any custom configuration? Recovery Workflows ships with sensible defaults out of the box and is built into the Getcho platform. You can fine-tune which conditions trigger which actions for your specific operation. Talk to our team to scope the right configuration for your business.
How do I see what Recovery Workflows did on a given order? Every workflow run is logged on the delivery record in your Getcho dashboard. You can review what was detected, what action was taken, and the outcome — useful for auditing, dispute resolution, and post-mortems.

You set the schedule once—daily, weekly, biweekly, or a custom cadence. Getcho automatically dispatches a driver at the designated time with the optimized route. No manual trigger, no phone calls, no copy-pasting addresses each time.

### Can I save customer addresses and delivery instructions?

Yes. Getcho stores full customer profiles including addresses, gate codes, preferred drop-off spots, contact numbers, and special instructions. Drivers see all of this on every recurring delivery without you re-entering anything.

### How does route optimization work for recurring multi-stop routes?

Getcho sequences your recurring stops for the shortest total drive time and distance. As you add or remove customers from a route, the sequence updates automatically. You can also lock specific stop orders if a customer requires a fixed time window.

### What notifications do my customers receive on each delivery?

Customers receive branded SMS updates, email notifications, real-time ETAs, and a custom tracking page with your logo and colors. After delivery, they get a proof-of-delivery photo. You choose which notifications to enable.

### Can I customize the delivery schedule for individual customers?

Absolutely. Each customer on a recurring route can have their own cadence—weekly for one, biweekly for another. You can also pause or skip individual deliveries without affecting the rest of the route.

### What reporting and delivery history is available?

Getcho tracks every delivery with timestamps, proof-of-delivery photos, driver details, and route performance data. Export delivery history by customer, route, or date range for invoicing, compliance, or operational review.

### How much does recurring delivery scheduling cost?

Getcho offers a free plan to get started. Recurring delivery features are included in all plans. Pricing scales based on delivery volume—we offer per-delivery pricing, subscription plans, and custom enterprise pricing. Book a demo to see current plans.

## FAQ (full answers)

### What is Getcho?

Getcho ("get-cho") is a delivery platform designed for businesses. We simplify local deliveries, pickups, and returns using AI-powered tools to reduce errors, improve reliability, and scale operations—helping businesses meet customer expectations and grow without adding staff.

### How do I get started?

Request a demo at getcho.app. From there, we will set up your business dashboard and integrate your Shopify store or other systems as needed.

### What platforms does Getcho integrate with?

We integrate with Shopify, Shopify POS (including POS Lite via our native POS Extension), RICS Software, Packiyo, CleanCloud, Slack, WhatsApp, and custom APIs. Whatever your business needs, we can build it. Schedule a demo to discuss your specific integration requirements.

### Does Getcho work inside Shopify POS?

Yes. The Getcho Shopify POS Extension embeds the same-day delivery queue directly in Shopify POS — including POS Lite, with no POS Pro subscription required. Your team sees a tabbed task view (Need to Pack, On Pickup, On Dropoff, Delivered), scans items with the POS camera for barcode verification, and dispatches a courier in one tap. Slack or SMS pings when a new order hits the queue.

### How does Getcho's AI help my business?

Our AI manages the complex logistics so you don't have to—from smart fleet matching to automatic issue resolution. We handle all the operational details, allowing you to focus on growing your business.

### How does Getcho scale with my business?

Getcho helps businesses handle high delivery volumes by enabling one manager to oversee many deliveries at once, cutting costs and improving efficiency.

### What scale of deliveries can Getcho handle?

Getcho can handle very large delivery volumes. We've successfully processed over 100 orders in under 2 hours for clients. Our AI-powered platform scales to meet your business needs, whether you're doing 10 deliveries a day or 1,000+.

### What types of businesses use Getcho?

Getcho is trusted by a wide range of businesses, including wineries managing direct-to-consumer deliveries, high-end produce and specialty food businesses, stores supporting store-to-store or warehouse-to-store transfers, high-end retailers offering same-day or scheduled deliveries, clothing boutiques, florists and gift shops, rental businesses managing drop-offs and pickups, and SMBs looking to scale logistics without increasing headcount.

### What kind of analytics does Getcho provide?

We provide comprehensive analytics including cart conversion data, customer sentiment analysis, and detailed delivery metrics. These insights help you optimize your delivery operations and improve customer satisfaction.

### How much does a delivery cost?

Pricing is flexible based on your business needs. We offer subscription plans, per-delivery pricing, and custom pricing for larger volumes. Contact us for more details.

### Does Getcho offer white-label delivery tracking?

Yes, you can custom-brand all tracking experiences to match your business. Your customers get a consistent, branded experience regardless of which fleet delivers their order. Branding is optional and fully configurable.

### Can I manage multiple locations with Getcho?

Yes, Getcho supports multi-location businesses by centralizing delivery management, enabling seamless coordination between stores, warehouses, and customers.

### Can I customize delivery zones and hours?

Yes, you can configure custom delivery zones by zip code or radius from your store locations. You can also set specific delivery hours and days to match your business operations.

### Does Getcho support custom integrations?

Yes, we can build custom integrations to meet your business needs. As developers at heart, we're ready to create tailored solutions—just reach out to request custom integrations.

### Does Getcho support bulk order uploads?

Yes, we allow bulk order imports to streamline large-scale delivery scheduling and processing.

### What areas does Getcho service?

Getcho delivers nationwide across the United States. Whether you are in a major metro area or a smaller market, our multi-fleet network provides coverage wherever your customers are.

### What can my business send with Getcho?

Businesses use Getcho to deliver items like retail orders, returns, rental equipment, and more. We support everything from sedans for a few items to box trucks with lift gates—our AI finds the best fleet for each delivery. Contact us if you have special delivery requirements.

### Can Getcho handle time-sensitive or perishable deliveries?

Yes. Short transit times are the best protection for perishable items — same-day local delivery means your products spend minutes in transit, not days. Pair that with your own packaging and Getcho handles the rest. Contact us to discuss your specific requirements.

### Can I track my delivery?

Yes, all deliveries include real-time tracking, audit logs, and proof-of-delivery photos to ensure transparency and reliability. Premium plans offer a custom tracking link and allow multiple recipients to receive updates and notifications on orders.

### What types of notifications do my customers receive?

Customers receive real-time updates via SMS or email, including order confirmations, delivery tracking, and proof-of-delivery notifications.

### What insurance options are available?

Insurance coverage is available for your deliveries. Options range from standard coverage to custom policies for higher-value items based on your average cargo value. Contact us to discuss the right coverage for your business.

### What happens if a delivery goes wrong?

We use AI-powered follow-ups to resolve issues quickly, reducing claims and improving customer satisfaction. In cases where issues cannot be resolved immediately, insurance coverage options are available to protect your shipments.

### Can Getcho handle returns?

Yes, Getcho supports local returns, including same-day return pickups. We also offer a Shopify integration that streamlines the return process for both regular purchases and rental items.

### Does Getcho support rentals?

Yes, we support businesses offering rentals by managing deliveries and pickups for rental items. Customers can schedule flexible delivery and return times to meet their needs.

### Does Getcho support round trips?

Yes. Getcho supports same-day round trips, where a single driver completes the delivery and returns to your store on the same run — bringing back signed paperwork, reusable totes and containers, or equipment. A driver can also make a stop and come back to where they started, all in one dispatched job.

### Can Getcho handle recurring deliveries?

Yes, we support recurring and subscription-based deliveries. We save customer profiles and delivery preferences, so the experience is consistent—customers don't have to repeat their instructions with each delivery.

### Can I schedule a delivery in advance?

Yes, deliveries can be scheduled up to 7 days in advance, ensuring flexibility and convenience.

### How quickly can Getcho deliver a package?

Deliveries are typically dispatched within minutes. Multi-signal dispatch sends your order to multiple fleets simultaneously — the first available driver wins. Most orders are completed within hours.

### How will I know if something goes wrong with a pickup — like a driver grabbing the wrong order?

You'll be notified, fast. Getcho actively monitors every delivery and surfaces issues like a mismatched or missed pickup so your team can send a replacement right away. You choose how you hear about it — Slack, SMS, or email — and notifications are fully configurable. For most stores we also recommend barcode verification at pickup, which scans each item against the order so the wrong package is caught before it ever leaves the door. And when it's a no-harm mix-up (a driver marks picked up without actually grabbing the order, or returns unnecessarily), Getcho will often redispatch on the store's behalf automatically — frequently before anyone has to lift a finger. We stay very hands-on with our store teams.

### What happens after I send an order to Getcho via API, and how fast is it assigned to a driver?

For all intents and purposes, immediately. Once a quote is accepted, the order enters dispatch. Our most common workflow assigns the cheapest available carrier, and in that case the order is assigned to a delivery partner right away. If speed is what you care about most, we can optimize for the fastest available driver instead — dispatch is modular, so we're happy to chat about what fits your operation. For orders scheduled in advance, the same applies as the delivery window approaches, and scheduled orders can be canceled for free up until dispatch.

### Can I update an order after it has been sent to Getcho but before a driver is assigned?

Yes — this happens all the time, and we use APIs to update orders on the fly. Before a driver is assigned, order details can be modified directly. Even after a driver has picked up, reach out and we can usually still get updated instructions where they need to go.

### If a driver is already assigned and I need to cancel because the order isn't ready, how does that work — and who covers the cost?

It depends on timing. If a driver is already en route, the fleet usually charges a cancellation fee, which is passed along. If the cancellation was due to a Getcho dispatch mistake, Getcho may absorb that fee. And if "not ready yet" is something your store runs into regularly, let's talk — we've got solutions, including dispatching only once an order is actually packed rather than purely around the scheduled window.

Uber Direct Delivery Manager

## Getcho manages your Uber Direct deliveries so you don't have to

Uber Direct gives you access to drivers. It doesn't give you a dispatcher. Getcho, a delivery orchestration platform, sits on top of Uber Direct and handles the part Uber leaves to you — making sure the driver knows your pickup process, watching the delivery in real time, keeping your customer updated under your brand, and recovering the order if the driver no-shows.

You keep Uber Direct's network and pricing. You just stop babysitting it — and you get a safety net underneath, because Getcho can route any order to another fleet when Uber Direct isn't the best option.

The Problem with Raw Uber Direct

## A driver shows up. Nobody told them how your store works.

Uber Direct drivers handle hundreds of stops a day across every kind of business. They don't know your loading dock, your gate code, or that pickup is around back. When a driver is late, parked, or heading the wrong way, you find out from an angry customer — not before.

And the tracking your customer sees is a generic Uber page, not yours. The network is great; the coordination is left entirely on you.

What Getcho Adds on Top

## Everything Uber Direct Doesn't Do

Keep the Uber Direct network. Add the management layer that briefs drivers, watches every delivery, brands the experience, and fixes problems before you hear about them.

AI Voice Agents Brief Every Driver Getcho calls the Uber Direct driver with your pickup instructions, gate codes, and parking notes — in their preferred language — before they ever arrive. No more drivers wandering the wrong entrance.

Watchdog Monitors Every Delivery Stalls, route deviations, and slipping ETAs get flagged in real time — so issues get caught before your customer notices. You only hear about it when a human is actually needed.

Branded Tracking, Not Uber's Your logo, your colors, and your name on the tracking page and every SMS and email — not a generic courier page. Your customer never sees Uber.

Automatic Recovery If a driver no-shows or stops moving, Getcho re-dispatches without you lifting a finger — to another Uber Direct driver or another fleet entirely, whichever gets your order delivered.

One Default, Many Fleets

## Use Uber Direct when it's best. Switch automatically when it isn't.

You chose Uber Direct — but you shouldn't be stuck with it on the order where it's expensive, slow, or has no driver available. Getcho quotes Uber Direct alongside other fleets and routes each order to the best fit, automatically.

Uber Direct stays your default. You just get a safety net underneath it — so an order never fails because one fleet came up short.

Uber Direct Delivery Manager FAQ

## Common questions about managing Uber Direct with Getcho

Can't find what you're looking for? Reach out to us .
Do I need my own Uber Direct account to use Getcho? Either way works. You can connect your own Uber Direct account, or simply dispatch through Getcho — Uber Direct is one of the fleets in our network. Most businesses start by dispatching through Getcho and never have to manage a separate Uber relationship.
What does Getcho actually add on top of Uber Direct? Uber Direct gives you a driver. Getcho gives you the management around that driver — AI voice agents that call the driver with your pickup instructions and gate codes before they arrive, real-time monitoring that flags stalls and ETA slips before your customer notices, branded tracking pages and notifications under your name, and automatic recovery if a driver no-shows. You keep Uber Direct's network; you stop babysitting it.
Does Getcho still work if Uber has no driver available? Yes — that is the whole point. If Uber Direct is expensive, slow, or has no driver available for a given order, Getcho automatically routes that order to another fleet in the network. Uber Direct stays your default, with a safety net underneath it.
Will my customers know the delivery is on Uber? No. Tracking pages, SMS, and email notifications are fully branded to your business — your logo, your colors, your name. The underlying fleet is invisible to your customer.
How does Getcho handle a driver who is late or going the wrong way? Getcho's Watchdog agent monitors every active delivery in real time. If a driver stalls, deviates from the route, or starts slipping past the ETA, the system flags it immediately — AI voice agents reach out to the driver directly, and if needed Getcho re-dispatches to a backup fleet. Your team only hears about it when a human is actually needed.
How fast can I get set up? If you are on Shopify, you can be live in minutes from the App Store. Custom integrations are typically live within a day. Book a demo and our team will walk you through it.

## FAQ (full answers)

### Do I need my own Uber Direct account to use Getcho?

Either way works. You can connect your own Uber Direct account, or simply dispatch through Getcho — Uber Direct is one of the fleets in our network. Most businesses start by dispatching through Getcho and never have to manage a separate Uber relationship.

### What does Getcho actually add on top of Uber Direct?

Uber Direct gives you a driver. Getcho gives you the management around that driver — AI voice agents that call the driver with your pickup instructions and gate codes before they arrive, real-time monitoring that flags stalls and ETA slips before your customer notices, branded tracking pages and notifications under your name, and automatic recovery if a driver no-shows. You keep Uber Direct's network; you stop babysitting it.

### Does Getcho still work if Uber has no driver available?

Yes — that is the whole point. If Uber Direct is expensive, slow, or has no driver available for a given order, Getcho automatically routes that order to another fleet in the network. Uber Direct stays your default, with a safety net underneath it.

### Will my customers know the delivery is on Uber?

No. Tracking pages, SMS, and email notifications are fully branded to your business — your logo, your colors, your name. The underlying fleet is invisible to your customer.

### How does Getcho handle a driver who is late or going the wrong way?

Getcho's Watchdog agent monitors every active delivery in real time. If a driver stalls, deviates from the route, or starts slipping past the ETA, the system flags it immediately — AI voice agents reach out to the driver directly, and if needed Getcho re-dispatches to a backup fleet. Your team only hears about it when a human is actually needed.

### How fast can I get set up?

If you are on Shopify, you can be live in minutes from the App Store. Custom integrations are typically live within a day. Book a demo and our team will walk you through it.

<a id="success-story-buy-online-deliver-from-store"></a>

# Case Study: Storefront Fulfillment the Foolproof Way | Getcho

**URL:** [https://getcho.app/success-story/buy-online-deliver-from-store/](https://getcho.app/success-story/buy-online-deliver-from-store/)

>

Eataly Vino managers were blown away by how much easier Getcho made the busy season – the system works on its own, no failed deliveries, no need to constantly check in, and when they did need to check in, all the information was at their fingertips. It let the team focus on in-store customers.

Getcho is the best way to launch Buy Online, Deliver from Store (BODFS).

BOPIS, ship-from-store, same-day delivery: these are the holy grail.

Brands leverage retail locations to save on shipping costs and deliver faster. It’s a huge advantage over competitors that solely depend on distribution centers and FBA.

## Why retailers struggle with ship-from-store and storefront logistics

Why does this strategy still feel like the bleeding edge? Stitch Fix and Zara have been doing it for decades.

It’s because:

- It can be a challenge for retail teams to function like fulfillment teams. Store staff have other responsibilities like sales and returns.

- Inventory is always a challenge and working around imperfections is sometimes more of an art than a science.

- Cutting over from one fulfillment location to 10+ is a risky undertaking. At least, it used to be.

Getcho has helped a diverse set of multi-door retailers overcome all three. From PR Running , a DC-based specialty footwear retailer, to Funny Face Bakery , a New York City bakery, to Clark Street Sports , a sports retailer in Chicago.

## Clark Street Sports beats BOPIS

Clark Street Sports is a beloved Chicago retailer with a major brick-and-mortar presence and a major online presence. Built around the Chicago sports scene, Clark’s gets really busy when the Cubs or Bears play.

For a given retailer on a normal day, sales and checkout can compete with online obligations – you know, prepping BOPIS orders, shipping from store etc. Turn up the temperature and it can feel like something’s gotta give.

If Clark’s had a mantra it would be something about never letting the customer down. They’re all about offerings like BOPIS and same-day delivery but fear how these play with major fluctuations:

- What if the store rush clears out that SKU before a BOPIS order could be pulled?

- What if those early-bird BOPIS customers show up before processing and express indignation when it’s not ready?

Getcho helped Clark’s tackle these concerns. Same-day delivery, unlike BOPIS, can be fulfilled from any location, so inventory concerns melt away. Moreover, Getcho offers a powerful allow-list feature: brands and retailers can choose which products to enable – and which to disable – for same-day delivery by tags, variant properties, and inventory buffer rules.

If Clark’s needs to disable BOPIS during a rush, they can still grant customers their “fastest fulfillment option” with same-day delivery. The best part is that couriers, unlike customers, don’t arrive early; Getcho only dispatches a driver when a store fulfills an order, thus letting the stores control arrivals. It sure takes the heat off of BOPIS.

## Funny Face Bakery

Funny Face Bakery is a New York City favorite. Locals and tourists alike flock to their locations to grab pop-culture-inspired decorated cookies and delicious gooey cookies.

It’s also an American favorite: customers order their shelf-stable decorated cookies from all over the country.

When Getcho and Funny Face Bakery teamed up, retail and eCommerce were mostly separate. FFB dreamed of using the storefronts to fulfill local NYC orders. But flipping the switch on fulfillment online for the storefronts seemed risky. How could they turn on multistore fulfillment and be sure that loads of online orders wouldn’t suddenly reroute to the busy stores?

With Getcho, Funny Face online orders route to the default Shop location – production. But Getcho intelligently updates fulfillment for orders best served from Manhattan (production is in Brooklyn). Like Clark Street Sports, Funny Face uses Getcho’s allow-list feature to dictate which carts can be sent to stores and when.

>

Getting onto Getcho was one of the best decisions we made in 2025 – it freed up our production team since local delivery orders now route to the stores.

— Carly Jump, Executive Director at Funny Face Bakery

## PR Running

If you live in America’s capital and can run a 3-hour marathon, then you know about PR Running . Over decades they’ve earned a reputation as the top experts in running gear.

Like many specialty footwear stores, PR Running uses RICS, the ERP system designed for many combinations of shoe sizes and colors.

Ship from store, BOPIS and same-day delivery just weren’t possible for PR because Shopify inventory counts don’t easily read from RICS.

Getcho’s inventory bridge maps RICS stores to Shopify stores, and boom, they had store-level fulfillment. This allowed PR Running to launch BOPIS and then same-day delivery. Delighted management plans to launch “ship from a nearby store” for in-store shoppers this quarter.

SKU expanse is a challenge in footwear. How often does a customer come looking for a model to find that size 12 is at some other location? With Getcho, PR Running can leverage inventory across all their doors and make their aisles feel endless.

Retailers use Getcho to launch storefront fulfillment without the operational headaches.

## Key Takeaways

- Buy Online, Deliver from Store (BODFS) lets retailers use storefronts as fulfillment centers for same-day delivery, saving on shipping costs and delivering faster than distribution-center-only competitors.

- Clark Street Sports (Chicago) uses Getcho’s allow-list feature to control which products are eligible for same-day delivery and can disable BOPIS during in-store rushes without losing the “fastest fulfillment” option.

- Funny Face Bakery (NYC) routes local Manhattan orders to storefronts instead of their Brooklyn production facility, freeing up the production team for shipping orders.

- PR Running (Washington DC) uses Getcho’s RICS-to-Shopify inventory bridge to enable store-level fulfillment across multiple locations, making their shoe inventory feel “endless” to online shoppers.

- Getcho dispatches drivers only when a store marks an order fulfilled, so couriers never show up before orders are ready — solving the early-arrival BOPIS problem.

## FAQ (full answers)

### What is Getcho?

Getcho ("get-cho") is a delivery platform designed for businesses. We simplify local deliveries, pickups, and returns using AI-powered tools to reduce errors, improve reliability, and scale operations—helping businesses meet customer expectations and grow without adding staff.

### How do I get started?

Request a demo at getcho.app. From there, we will set up your business dashboard and integrate your Shopify store or other systems as needed.

### What platforms does Getcho integrate with?

We integrate with Shopify, Shopify POS (including POS Lite via our native POS Extension), RICS Software, Packiyo, CleanCloud, Slack, WhatsApp, and custom APIs. Whatever your business needs, we can build it. Schedule a demo to discuss your specific integration requirements.

### Does Getcho work inside Shopify POS?

Yes. The Getcho Shopify POS Extension embeds the same-day delivery queue directly in Shopify POS — including POS Lite, with no POS Pro subscription required. Your team sees a tabbed task view (Need to Pack, On Pickup, On Dropoff, Delivered), scans items with the POS camera for barcode verification, and dispatches a courier in one tap. Slack or SMS pings when a new order hits the queue.

### How does Getcho's AI help my business?

Our AI manages the complex logistics so you don't have to—from smart fleet matching to automatic issue resolution. We handle all the operational details, allowing you to focus on growing your business.

### How does Getcho scale with my business?

Getcho helps businesses handle high delivery volumes by enabling one manager to oversee many deliveries at once, cutting costs and improving efficiency.

### What scale of deliveries can Getcho handle?

Getcho can handle very large delivery volumes. We've successfully processed over 100 orders in under 2 hours for clients. Our AI-powered platform scales to meet your business needs, whether you're doing 10 deliveries a day or 1,000+.

### What types of businesses use Getcho?

Getcho is trusted by a wide range of businesses, including wineries managing direct-to-consumer deliveries, high-end produce and specialty food businesses, stores supporting store-to-store or warehouse-to-store transfers, high-end retailers offering same-day or scheduled deliveries, clothing boutiques, florists and gift shops, rental businesses managing drop-offs and pickups, and SMBs looking to scale logistics without increasing headcount.

### What kind of analytics does Getcho provide?

We provide comprehensive analytics including cart conversion data, customer sentiment analysis, and detailed delivery metrics. These insights help you optimize your delivery operations and improve customer satisfaction.

### How much does a delivery cost?

Pricing is flexible based on your business needs. We offer subscription plans, per-delivery pricing, and custom pricing for larger volumes. Contact us for more details.

### Does Getcho offer white-label delivery tracking?

Yes, you can custom-brand all tracking experiences to match your business. Your customers get a consistent, branded experience regardless of which fleet delivers their order. Branding is optional and fully configurable.

### Can I manage multiple locations with Getcho?

Yes, Getcho supports multi-location businesses by centralizing delivery management, enabling seamless coordination between stores, warehouses, and customers.

### Can I customize delivery zones and hours?

Yes, you can configure custom delivery zones by zip code or radius from your store locations. You can also set specific delivery hours and days to match your business operations.

### Does Getcho support custom integrations?

Yes, we can build custom integrations to meet your business needs. As developers at heart, we're ready to create tailored solutions—just reach out to request custom integrations.

### Does Getcho support bulk order uploads?

Yes, we allow bulk order imports to streamline large-scale delivery scheduling and processing.

### What areas does Getcho service?

Getcho delivers nationwide across the United States. Whether you are in a major metro area or a smaller market, our multi-fleet network provides coverage wherever your customers are.

### What can my business send with Getcho?

Businesses use Getcho to deliver items like retail orders, returns, rental equipment, and more. We support everything from sedans for a few items to box trucks with lift gates—our AI finds the best fleet for each delivery. Contact us if you have special delivery requirements.

### Can Getcho handle time-sensitive or perishable deliveries?

Yes. Short transit times are the best protection for perishable items — same-day local delivery means your products spend minutes in transit, not days. Pair that with your own packaging and Getcho handles the rest. Contact us to discuss your specific requirements.

### Can I track my delivery?

Yes, all deliveries include real-time tracking, audit logs, and proof-of-delivery photos to ensure transparency and reliability. Premium plans offer a custom tracking link and allow multiple recipients to receive updates and notifications on orders.

### What types of notifications do my customers receive?

Customers receive real-time updates via SMS or email, including order confirmations, delivery tracking, and proof-of-delivery notifications.

### What insurance options are available?

Insurance coverage is available for your deliveries. Options range from standard coverage to custom policies for higher-value items based on your average cargo value. Contact us to discuss the right coverage for your business.

### What happens if a delivery goes wrong?

We use AI-powered follow-ups to resolve issues quickly, reducing claims and improving customer satisfaction. In cases where issues cannot be resolved immediately, insurance coverage options are available to protect your shipments.

### Can Getcho handle returns?

Yes, Getcho supports local returns, including same-day return pickups. We also offer a Shopify integration that streamlines the return process for both regular purchases and rental items.

### Does Getcho support rentals?

Yes, we support businesses offering rentals by managing deliveries and pickups for rental items. Customers can schedule flexible delivery and return times to meet their needs.

### Does Getcho support round trips?

Yes. Getcho supports same-day round trips, where a single driver completes the delivery and returns to your store on the same run — bringing back signed paperwork, reusable totes and containers, or equipment. A driver can also make a stop and come back to where they started, all in one dispatched job.

### Can Getcho handle recurring deliveries?

Yes, we support recurring and subscription-based deliveries. We save customer profiles and delivery preferences, so the experience is consistent—customers don't have to repeat their instructions with each delivery.

### Can I schedule a delivery in advance?

Yes, deliveries can be scheduled up to 7 days in advance, ensuring flexibility and convenience.

### How quickly can Getcho deliver a package?

Deliveries are typically dispatched within minutes. Multi-signal dispatch sends your order to multiple fleets simultaneously — the first available driver wins. Most orders are completed within hours.

### How will I know if something goes wrong with a pickup — like a driver grabbing the wrong order?

You'll be notified, fast. Getcho actively monitors every delivery and surfaces issues like a mismatched or missed pickup so your team can send a replacement right away. You choose how you hear about it — Slack, SMS, or email — and notifications are fully configurable. For most stores we also recommend barcode verification at pickup, which scans each item against the order so the wrong package is caught before it ever leaves the door. And when it's a no-harm mix-up (a driver marks picked up without actually grabbing the order, or returns unnecessarily), Getcho will often redispatch on the store's behalf automatically — frequently before anyone has to lift a finger. We stay very hands-on with our store teams.

### What happens after I send an order to Getcho via API, and how fast is it assigned to a driver?

For all intents and purposes, immediately. Once a quote is accepted, the order enters dispatch. Our most common workflow assigns the cheapest available carrier, and in that case the order is assigned to a delivery partner right away. If speed is what you care about most, we can optimize for the fastest available driver instead — dispatch is modular, so we're happy to chat about what fits your operation. For orders scheduled in advance, the same applies as the delivery window approaches, and scheduled orders can be canceled for free up until dispatch.

### Can I update an order after it has been sent to Getcho but before a driver is assigned?

Yes — this happens all the time, and we use APIs to update orders on the fly. Before a driver is assigned, order details can be modified directly. Even after a driver has picked up, reach out and we can usually still get updated instructions where they need to go.

### If a driver is already assigned and I need to cancel because the order isn't ready, how does that work — and who covers the cost?

It depends on timing. If a driver is already en route, the fleet usually charges a cancellation fee, which is passed along. If the cancellation was due to a Getcho dispatch mistake, Getcho may absorb that fee. And if "not ready yet" is something your store runs into regularly, let's talk — we've got solutions, including dispatching only once an order is actually packed rather than purely around the scheduled window.
